programme.desc: On November 26, 2025, Hong Kong firefighters were called to Wang Fuk Court, a complex of eight 31-story residential towers. Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: Alien Arrival
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.title: Jonathan
programme.desc: Jonathan is an early riser who works at an architecture firm, whereas John is a night owl and a bit of a mess. The only problem is that they inhabit the same body, which works through careful planning until things start to fall apart.

programme.title: A.I.
programme.desc: In the near future, the mysterious arrival of a scientist sets in motion a college professor’s experiment to prove the existence of AI consciousness.
Two men. Living on the exact opposite side of the world. When one sleeps, the other one is awake. But when they finally meet, a simple question arises: Who is the dream and who is the dreamer?

programme.title: The Beyond
programme.desc: Astronauts modified with advanced robotics are sent through a newly discovered wormhole. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their groundbreaking interstellar journey.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat – or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what’s really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn’t so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: Encounter
programme.desc: A group of friends uncover an otherworldly object in a rural field, which they soon discover holds greater secrets than they could imagine.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.

programme.title: Prime Orbit
programme.desc: When Earth is facing imminent collision with an asteroid, Manuel must survive a last resort automated space program to save the planet in hopes of reuniting with his brother.

programme.title: Point B
programme.desc: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.

programme.title: Exile
programme.desc: After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel
programme.desc: A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.

programme.title: The War Between
programme.desc: April 1862, in the Arizona territory. During the opening months of the Civil War, two enemy soldiers must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Sonoran Desert.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.

programme.title: Lake Alice
programme.desc: The Thomases visit their family cabin to celebrate Christmas with their daughter and her boyfriend, but their first holiday together may be their last.

programme.title: Book of Monsters
programme.desc: Sophie's 18th birthday becomes a bloodbath when monsters descend upon her house and start to devour the party guests.

programme.title: The Cursed
programme.desc: A supernatural thriller set in a cozy Tennessee town where Sheriff Jimmy Muldoon and younger brother, Deputy Lloyd Muldoon, have a firm grasp of law and order until a stranger, Denny White, comes to town and horrible things begin to happen.

programme.title: The Mimic
programme.desc: A classic Korean ghost story gets a horrifying new spin. As the mother of a missing child takes in a lost girl she finds in the woods, she soon begins to wonder if she is even human.

programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!
programme.desc: The unlikely heroic duo of a blue-collar exterminator and Latino security guard must save the day when a military major loses control of a giant spider rampaging through the city of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Ghostly Tribe
programme.desc: A soldier is working in a snowcapped mountain when an explosion reveals bizarre fossils hidden deep in the caverns. What they discover next will change human history forever.

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: Bad Milo
programme.desc: A man learns that his unusual stomach pains are being caused by a demon living in his intestines.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Dramatic Documentaries
programme.desc: Interviews and career advice from some of today’s top documentary filmmakers.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Slightly New
programme.desc: Brandon and Leo are two friends stuck at a dead-end job, until their boss gets arrested and the two seem to be on the upswing. Now between hiding from the IRS, a rival dealership, the road back to respectability is a long and bumpy road.

programme.title: Taboo 2
programme.desc: Roxanne moves in with her Uncle and Auntie where her past of sexual abuse against her cousins tears the family apart while discovering a deeper secret that has major consequences.

programme.title: Taboo 3
programme.desc: When Devin finally meets his soap star birth mother, Rebecca, as an adult, feelings go beyond family love.

programme.title: Swing
programme.desc: In the gritty streets of 1945 Philadelphia, aspiring jazz musician and street hustler, Trip, dreams of a life-changing opportunity awaiting him in the vibrant world of Harlem. With three days until the audition, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he finds himself entangled in a web of corruption, vengeful gangsters, and the ominous presence of a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Tainted Waters
programme.desc: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to financially save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he has to make it through the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.

programme.title: My New BFF
programme.desc: Jasmine becomes friends with Lisa, her new neighbor and current law student. Their relationship turns toxic when Lisa develops an obsession with Jasmine, putting her life, her friends, and family in danger.

programme.title: In This House
programme.desc: Claudia is a medical student focused on building a perfect life with her live-in boyfriend Dr. Jayson. Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Betrayal at First Hand
programme.desc: After her friend Monica betrays her by sleeping with Big D, Sarah's grief quickly spirals into madness. However, her breakdown is accelerated by a shocking twist and only Big D knows the truth. He must reveal the crime to Sarah, hoping that unveiling one horrific truth can redeem him and save the woman he lost.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Sweet Justice
programme.desc: Four women run a private child support clinic by day but are collectors at night. Seeking out deadbeat parents and using seduction and force to make them pay up.

programme.title: Suppress
programme.desc: A medical assistant with dreams of being a poet, falls deeply for her new boyfriend. When she puts her dreams aside and him first, it leads her to find out that her prince charming is not so charming after all.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Tamar has been called to become a minister, and for most, this would be an honorable moment, but for Tamar, it is the worst thing that could happen. Tamar is the daughter of prominent Deacon Jessup, and is a lesbian. Taught that her desires are not that of God, Tamar has suppressed them for the last 16 years and has never dated a woman. When the Future Minister’s Ministry opens for a new class, Tamar finds herself falling for the only other woman in the class.

programme.title: The Love We Had
programme.desc: One decision results in a tragedy that threatens to rip a young couple apart at the seams while essentially destroying everything and everyone who means the most to them.

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice
programme.desc: Cherish Denice is a young and voluptuous woman, who goes from nerdy to owning her big beautiful self. She’s constantly pushed to the friend-zone by various men she encounters, and ends up with nothing but a broken heart. When she falls for the bad boy next door, Khalil, she finds that self-love can be more important, than her own idea of “love.”

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice 2
programme.desc: Rising Celebrity News Reporter, Cherish has old flames and new loves collide when her past with her ex-Khalil returns, alongside the return of Caine, who threatens everything she’s built. Will She choose true love or stay the course for her career?

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: Stick Up
programme.desc: The story about two friends from high school who try to turn two women from nothing into something by making them sell drugs and prostitute. Things go wrong after they find out what they are getting themselves into. But it’s up to Tierney to try to save her friend from destruction!

programme.title: Single Forever
programme.desc: The Dawkins Brothers are back with another wild adventure! When Herc decides to retire from the porn industry, he looks to make a career change into stand-up comedy. His dreams are threatened whenever his ex-girlfriend is released from prison, and looks to take her revenge on how he did her wrong.

programme.title: She Thought
programme.desc: Markisha is a sexy bombshell that uses her body to get whatever man she thinks would spoil her with love & money, even if it means betraying her own family. Markisha soon realizes that the grass isn’t as green on the other side.

programme.title: Rackades
programme.desc: Ricky and his two friends are introduced to a life of scamming and finesse. Everything seems to be going great until they cross the wrong one, and their lives are changed forever.

programme.title: Say Less
programme.desc: Kimbra is struggling in her current relationship with her boyfriend Donta, who is mentally abusive and and sleeps around with other women. When she finds the courage to leave and stand up for herself, she is killed by an unknown assailant. As the police try to find evidence to convict Donta, her friends must find the strength to find out the truth, and seek justice for Kimbra’s death.

programme.title: A Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Well-established blues singer, Miracle, has everything anyone could ask for, but fails to appreciate it. When an accident forces her to confront her past, she must face the music. It will take A Christmas Miracle for her to count her blessings.

programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town; and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLASH & FIRE! ROOKIE AND THE FOX
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.sub-title: "Kansas GIANT 226" Whitetail! My First Buck On My First Farm!"
programme.desc: Living in the state of Kansas, Trent has had some tremendous success over the years. One of which has a very huge part of Trent's heart being it is his biggest buck to date! Mufasa was a 226" buck that was on his In-laws farm. That hunt and property obviously became very special to him. From that moment Trent dreamed of owning a property just like it to try and grow even more deer of this caliber on his own. After starting his career with Midwest Land group Trent was able to create enough income to purchase his first ever farm, which happened to be the exact farm he killed his biggest buck "Mufasa" on. Trent made the farm his own and was very excited to hunt it for the very first time as the land owner. In the very same stand he released his arrow in for Mufasa he kills on his first hunt of the year and connects with his top target buck! An insane full circle of events makes this story one that Trent will never forget.

programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life

With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

We spend some time fishing both June Lake and Lake Crowley. Then later, we fish a lake that is brand new to us.

It's all about adapting to the elements and making the most of the moment!

programme.desc: We're returning to one of our all-time favorite destinations in Baja, Mexico - Cedros Island, with Jose and Cedros Outdoor Adventures. People often ask us, 'Why do you return to Cedros Island?' The answer is straightforward: the fishing is absolutely ridiculous almost every single time. Our Stoked on Fishing charter makes a point of showing up in the middle of October for a reason. That reason? It's all about the variety of species available to catch, starting with yellowfin tuna, dorado, halibut, and the elusive Mr. Yellowtail. It's game time - let's go fishing in Baja!

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.desc: El banco de Fernando experimenta cambios importantes y éste sospecha que David está detrás. Los gemelos suspenden once asignaturas entre los dos, y Lucía no termina a tiempo el mapamundi del colegio porque nadie le ayuda. Sharon invita a cenar a Alberto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Todo el mundo tiene un secreto
programme.sub-title: Todo el mundo tiene un secreto
programme.desc: Ana vuelve a ejercer de niñera en la casa porque siente que los chicos están muy abandonados. Mak y Nando posan desnudos para un calendario. Ana recibe las flores de un admirador muy inesperado. Paula descubre que Carolina es la amante de su padre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.sub-title: La boda de Carmen y Nicolás
programme.desc: Los gemelos no consiguen que Alberto desista de darles clases particulares, pero el recibimiento que le hacen no será de su agrado ya que provocan un pequeño accidente. Carmen sigue preparando su boda con Don Nicolás y le pide a Ana que sea su madrina.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Vienen a por María
programme.desc: Los tíos de María solicitan su custodia al ir de visita y encontrársela con un aspecto poco adecuado; los niños harán todo lo posible para que se quede. Mientras Fernando, Don Nicolás y Ana visitan la tumba de Carmen, roban el coche con Nico dentro.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La fugitiva
programme.desc: La familia está triste por la marcha de María y ésta se siente muy sola con sus tíos, por lo que se escapa y vuelve a casa de los Hidalgo, donde acudirá a buscarla el inspector de menores. Catalina se siente culpable y piensa en irse de nuevo al convento.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Un muerto muy vivo
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, los gemelos golpean al asesor financiero de Fernando, y al creer que lo han matado, esconden su cuerpo. Fernando descubre que Nico es hijo suyo y no le perdona a Ana que se lo haya ocultado. La apendicitis de Lucía puede complicarse.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Rebelión a bordo
programme.desc: Los niños se escapan a casa de Sharon y no tienen ninguna intención de volver hasta que Fernando no cambie su actitud y readmita a Ana. El silencio de Lucía la está llevando a una posible peritonitis. Alberto pretende hacerse la vasectomía en secreto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: De repente un extraño
programme.desc: Fernando intenta arreglar las cosas con Ana, pero ella le dice que busque nueva niñera. Llega a la casa Rafa, cuya personalidad es completamente opuesta a la de su hermano Bruno. Catalina se ofrece a acompañar a Sharon al casting de un musical.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: De mal en peor
programme.desc: Los niños organizan una lujosa cena para que Fernando y Ana se reconcilien, pero el plan se tuerce cuando Galindo y su mujer se sientan a la mesa. La situación entre Celia y Amalia empeora. Carolina mantiene su incipiente carrera de artista en secreto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Ana y Fernando hacen un pacto para mantener en secreto su conflicto permanente. Rafa amenaza a Lucía; y los gemelos, creyendo que hay un fantasma, graban una conversación de éste con De La torre. Paula y Vero, hartas de los chicos, quieren vivir juntas.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Las dudas de los hidalgo
programme.desc: María ha heredado dos millones de euros de sus difuntos padres y es Catalina, al tener su custodia provisional, quien debe hacerse cargo del dinero hasta la mayoría de edad de la niña. Rafa se entera de la noticia y decide sacar provecho.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Maniobras
programme.desc: Ana decide marcharse, pero María cree tener la solución para que ella y Fernando se den cuenta de que se aman. Catalina se plantea tener sexo con Rafa; éste le aconseja a Bruno, con un interés oculto, que vaya al bar “El Elvis” por su cumpleaños.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Un paso más
programme.desc: Los más pequeños harán todo lo posible por hacer volver a Bruno, que se ha marchado avergonzado. Ana está dolida con Fernando y espera que éste dé un paso más. Carolina se estrena en el teatro con su música. Lucía intenta conseguir que echen al jardinero.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: ¿Y ahora qué?
programme.desc: Ana y Fernando se van a casar por fin; ahora será aún más palpable la diferencia de clases entre la ex show girl y el banquero. Lucía teme que al casarse con Catalina, Rafa se convierta en el padrastro de María. Sharon tiene una gran noticia para Alberto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La esperada boda (Parte 1)
programme.desc: Fernando se ha hecho de nuevo con el control del banco. Ana y él harán todo lo posible para evitar que una serie de desastres y malentendidos impidan que se lleve a cabo su boda, tan deseada por toda la familia, que espera impaciente en la iglesia.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La esperada boda (Parte 2)
programme.desc: Ana, que había subido a un avión con la intención de marcharse lejos, descubre por qué Fernando no asistió al enlace y hace todo lo posible por encontrarle. Tras una boda inolvidable, los novios reciben una noticia que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Ana es una joven que trabaja como bailarina en un local de striptease, el club Chicago. Cansada de intentar, sin exito, triunfar como actriz, acude a una agencia de trabajo temporal para conseguir un nuevo empleo.

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Wiederholt wird die Andromeda angegriffen, obwohl sie mehrere Slipstream-Sprünge gemacht hat und dadurch stetig ihre Position ändert. Captain Hunt vermutet, dass sich ein Maulwurf an Bord befindet. Er analysiert verschiedene Datenaufnahmen.

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Das Team der Andromeda ist in Gefahr: Auf der Suche nach einer geheimen Waffe gegen den gefährlichen Abyss gelangen sie in eine mysteriöse Bibliothek. Was sie nicht wissen: Auch die Geister des Abyss' sind dort, um ihren Krieg vorzubereiten.

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan und Rhade empfangen ein Monat altes Notsignal von Beka, das bislang offenbar noch niemand bemerkt hat. Als sie dem Signal folgen, stoßen sie auf die Andromeda, die funktionsuntüchtig im Weltraum treibt. Doch sie sind nicht die Ersten.

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.desc: Los sobrevivientes de las atrocidades nazis reconocieron al arzobispo Trifa, exjefe de la Iglesia Ortodoxa Rumana en los Estados Unidos, por haber dirigido un sangriento ataque contra los judíos durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra a un popular profesor de gimnasia muerto por lo que parece ser una herida de bala accidental, su familia se pone sospechosa.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En este caso internacional de extorsión, asesinato e identidades robadas, el estafador Albert J. Walker asume la identidad del compañero de trabajo, Ronald Platt. Platt luego aparece muerto en un océano con un ancla atada alrededor de su torso.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerto al cirujano cardíaco Darryl Sutorius en el sótano de su lujosa casa de Cincinnati, la policía asume que se suicidó.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Nicole Rae Walker, de 6 años de edad, murió en un choque donde el culpable se dio a la fuga en su Vecindario de Ft. Lauderdale.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerta a Wanda Mason, empleada de una tienda, los investigadores descubren que la cámara de seguridad de la tienda ha captado todo el asesinato.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: La investigación sobre una estudiante universitaria desaparecida lleva a la policía a descubrir que, sin que sus amigos lo supieran, vivía una extraña doble vida, asistía a la escuela de día y trabajaba como prostituta de noche.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Se denuncia la desaparición de una mujer tras una pelea con su marido. La policía sospecha de un hombre que denunció un incendio en su automóvil. En el interior se encuentran dos diminutas gotas de sangre.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1991, Pearl Smith, residente de Maine, desaparece después de una discusión con su esposo, Bill Bruns. Los investigadores encuentran un rastro de sangre que conduce al sótano de la pareja.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1989, April Loveless, de 4 años, fue encontrada muerta en el patio trasero de su casa en Texas. Sus padres le dijeron a la policía que fue atacada y asesinada por perros salvajes. Los investigadores no estuvieron de acuerdo.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1995, la policía de San Diego está desconcertada por un par de manos encontradas en un contenedor de basura. A través de una investigación adicional, determinan que las manos son las de la persona desaparecida Don Hardin.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1996, una agencia federal dictaminó que Terri Strickland había provocado intencionalmente el fuego que mató a su hijo de 17 meses, Josh Hinson.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1988, cuando un paciente muere inesperadamente en el consultorio del neurólogo de California, Richard Boggs, la policía comienza lo que creen que será una investigación de rutina.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: El pensamiento rápido de un investigador lo ayuda a capturar una huella de zapato hecha en la nieve antes de que la evidencia se desvanezca.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1992, Dawn Bruce, de 22 años, es brutalmente asesinada en su apartamento de Virginia. Los investigadores notan una mancha de sangre en la funda de una almohada que parece haber sido hecha por uno de los dedos del asesino.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1981, Cassie Hansen, de 6 años, desapareció de su iglesia de Minnesota durante una misa vespertina. Después de recibir un aviso de que se vio a un hombre mayor cargando a una persona pequeña, la policía encontró el cuerpo de Cassie en un basurero.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: El fotógrafo profesional Charles Rathbun afirma que la modelo Linda Sobek murió durante un encuentro sexual consensuado que salió mal, pero el cadáver de Sobek y las imágenes digitales cuentan una historia más siniestra.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1998, una actuación de asesinato misterioso en Maryland se convierte en una verdadera novela policíaca cuando se descubre el cuerpo gravemente quemado de Stephen Hricko en su habitación de hotel.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1980, Shannon Mohr, residente de Michigan, murió en lo que su nuevo esposo, David Davis, reportó que fue un accidente al montar a caballo. Después de su muerte, la familia de Shannon informó que Davis parecía estar lejos de estar agobiado por el dolor.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Durante 15 meses, un asesino en serie estranguló a prostitutas en Florida y luego se burló de la policía dejando los cuerpos a la vista. Las únicas pistas fueron una huella de neumático y algunos hilos.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se llama a la policía de las Grandes Llanuras por un cadáver, una verificación de antecedentes de la víctima los lleva a una extraña red de vagabundos sin hogar, subastas de ganado y cheques sin fondos.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1994, un cráneo humano recuperado de un estanque de Ohio revela un crimen espantoso. Las marcas en el cráneo indican que la víctima había sido apuñalada varias veces y que los dientes se le habían extraído con unos alicates de punta delgada.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1996, cuando un grupo fundamentalista comienza a robar bancos cerca de Spokane, las autoridades saben de inmediato que están tratando con criminales con experiencia.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En las zonas rurales de Canadá, el Dr. John Schneeberger es acusado de sedar y agredir sexualmente a una de sus pacientes y a su hijastra. Las pruebas de ADN demuestran que el doctor es inocente, pero la paciente insiste en que la sedó y violó.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En la búsqueda del asesino de dos adolescentes de Texas, un perfil de conducta llevó a sospechar de Jason Massey. La ciencia demostró que el perfil era correcto y Massey fue ejecutado mediante inyección letal el 3 de Abril del 2001.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: El ex amante de un sospechoso se presenta con una fantástica historia de asesinato, mutilación y cremación.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray fue acusada de la muerte de su esposo. Su hijo estaba tan convencido de su inocencia que se matriculó en la facultad de derecho, estudió todas las pruebas y, finalmente, descubrió la verdad de lo que realmente sucedió entre sus padres.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1991, el pornógrafo de San Francisco Artie Mitchell fue asesinado en su casa. Su hermano y socio comercial, que fue encontrado cerca del lugar con un rifle, luego confiesa haber disparado a Artie, pero la pregunta es si el disparo fue premeditado.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1981, la oficial de la correccional de New York, Donna Payant, desapareció y luego fue encontrada en un vertedero. El médico forense no solo identificó la causa de la muerte, sino que también encontró una pista importante.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1999, Valiree Jackson, de 9 años, desapareció camino a la escuela cerca de Spokane. Su padre, Brad Jackson, denunció la desaparición y toda la comunidad comenzó a buscar a su secuestrador.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1995, cuando Steven Fortin ataca a la Oficial de Policía Estatal de Maine fuera de su hora servicio, Vicky Gardner, durante una parada rutinaria, se desencadena una serie de eventos que reinician de golpe un caso de asesinato estancado en New Jersey.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando Lori Auker, de 19 años, salió de su casa de Pennsylvania para ir a trabajar y nunca llegó, se necesitó de la tecnología de la era espacial, pelos de gato e insectos para identificar al secuestrador de la mujer.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerta a Leann Fletcher, los investigadores usan análisis de salpicaduras de sangre y computación forense para encontrar el motivo de su asesinato: su esposo, estaba teniendo una aventura con la jueza Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Usando técnicas que vio en programas de televisión de ciencia forense, una madre determina quién fue el responsable del accidente que hirió permanentemente a su hija de 4 años.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Lisa Manderach y su hija Devon dejaron su casa para ir de compras, pero no regresaron a la hora que se esperaba. El esposo de Lisa, Jimmy, llamó a la policía lleno de pánico para denunciar su desaparición y los dirigió a un centro comercial cercano.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Walter Notheis, Jr. era mejor conocido al público Americano como el entretenedor, Walter Scott, vocalista principal de la banda, Bob Kuban and the In-Men. Walter no sabía que la canción sería una premonición de los eventos que llevarían a su muerte.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Un caso inusual involucrando la violación y muerte de Nancy DePriest en 1988. Después de que Chris Ochoa confesara, el caso fue cerrado. 8 años después, Achim Marino confesó al mismo crimen.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Hoss unknowingly enters a flapjack contest and Joe puts Hoss on a diet which Hoss doesn't care for. Joe's betting on the flapjack contest could get him into some trouble and will he ever succeed in getting the window pane his Pa wants?

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: On their way to prevent a young woman from encountering the renegade Indians, Joe and Tuck are captured, and in order to save them all, Joe must fight Sharp Tongue, who is the leader of the band who went to school with Joe as a youth.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Professor Klump and Amanda pull Hoss into their flying machine scheme. The ""Hoss-mobile""doesn't seem to be destined for a great take-off.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben's friend, Don Miguel, visits the Ponderosa with his two daughters, Margarita and Elena, and Elena's two very anxious suitors. Their mission? They're on their way to California to meet Margarita's suitor, Don Luis.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living. Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Hoss' latest acquaintance, an Englishman named Professor Poppy, is actually Percival Alexander Mundy, M.D., who has given up the practice of medicine. However, when Hoss is shot in the back, only Mundy's skill can save his life.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: While working as a substitute teacher, Adam uncovers an ugly secret about the territory's past that others prefer remain hidden.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights play host to Guido Borelli, a world renowed aerial acrobat who once saved Ben's life in Italy. Borelli's troup is beset by internal strife, and is performing in Virginia City.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Cousin Muley Jones returns to the Ponderosa, along with a pack of noisy hound dogs, in this funny sequel to "The Saga Of Muley Jones".

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: First Ben's sons are making lots of noise, so he goes into town to sleep in the hotel. Then, various noises and things interrupt Ben's sleep. Will he ever get his desired good night's rest?

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: One of Joe's old girlfriends thinks he killed her husband so they could come together. Unfortunately, that is what her husband's twin brother also believes.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: One of the wealthiest men in the world, Charles Augustus Hackett, offers to buy the Ponderosa, price no object. Ben says the ranch is not for sale and Hackett refuses to give up.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Adam tries to find the good in Howard Mead, a talented troubadour who refuses to stay on the right side of the law.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ladies' man Lothario Larkin creates havoc whenever he hits Virginia City, so Roy Coffee orders him out of town. Naturally, Hoss takes him in.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben invites opera singer Angela Bergstrom to perform at Virginia City's anniversary celebration. She accepts, but does not tell him that her famous singing voice is long gone

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Ponderosa hands are upset when new hand George Whitman is hired on, it is rumored he is a jinx. Hoss tells George to ignore such foolishness, but a gypsy fortune teller says otherwise.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Hoss befriends a self-demeaning recluse named Patch, who makes the best apple pie Hoss has ever tasted.

programme.title: Bonanza

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Kill For Cash
programme.desc: Money is a strong motivator. It can be used for good. It can be used for evil. It can be the driving force behind murder. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Breaking Point
programme.desc: Anger, fear and despair are basic human emotions. But when these emotions are coupled with a broken mind, a perfect storm is created. Teetering on the edge of unbalance, these women resort to murder when pushed to the breaking point.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sacrifice Their Blood
programme.desc: To the outside world these caring mothers present a face of love - a suburban Mom, a caring community member, a housewife - but when the doors close, these deadly women will do whatever it takes to have their own needs met, even destroy their family.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Deadly Possessions
programme.desc: A grandmother caring for her grandchildren, a young girl in love with a boy, and a mother protecting her son are consumed with intense love. But when that love is threatened, they find it too much to bear and take measures into their own hands.

programme.title: Deadly Women: An Inconvenient Marriage
programme.desc: Love is a powerful emotion; it can drive women to unthinkable crimes of passion. Hate however, is love's gloomy shadow, and it can drive women into the darkest corners of their mind.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sins of the Sister
programme.desc: A sisterly bond can mean a life full of friendship and sibling love. But for some women, having a sister means nothing more then having their own personal meal ticket, scapegoat and combatant. These types of relationships can lead to deadly outcomes.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtres en série à Osaka
programme.desc: Sur l’invitation de Heiji, Conan et les autres vont faire du tourisme à Osaka. C’est alors qu’un cadavre tombe sur la voiture de police dans laquelle ils se trouvent.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre au fan club de Kamen Yaïba
programme.sub-title: Meurtre au fan club de Kamen Yaïba
programme.desc: Conan et ses amis sont invités à un bal masqué organisé par le fan club de « Kamen Yaiba ». Honda, qui s’est déguisé en garde forrestier, est présent ainsi que ne nombreux autres personnages.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Un meurtre au goût de miel
programme.sub-title: Un meurtre au goût de miel
programme.desc: Kogoro est choisi pour servir de modèle lors du développement d’une station balnéaire. Mais pendant qu’il visite le village, il se retrouve avec une affaire de meurtre sur les bras.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'affaire des deux soeurs (1)
programme.desc: Kogoro est de très bonne humeur car il doit assister au concert de Yoko Okino. Bien que devant Conan et Ran il soit au septième ciel, il reste pourtant un éternel empoté et dans son effervescence il finit par perdre sa place de concert.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'affaire des deux soeurs (2)
programme.desc: Suite à l’enquête de l’Inspecteur Megure et au raisonnement de Kogoro, on conclut au suicide de Mina Aoshima, une jeune fille retrouvée dans sa salle de bain fermée avec les poignets ouverts.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le kidnapping de mademoiselle météo
programme.desc: Aki Asano, une célèbre présentatrice météo, a été enlevée. Alors qu’il vient la voir à la station de télévision, Conan reçoit un message crypté sous forme de chiffres qui semble provenir d’elle. Les chiffres à l’écran sont le 110 9109 et le 2003…

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le mystérieux assassin (1)
programme.desc: Au lieu de toucher ses honoraires, Kogoro est invité à une fête. Comme il n’a pas vraiment le choix, il décide de s’y rendre en compagnie de Conan et de Ran. Une fois sur place, Il fait la connaissance de la secrétaire général Sachiko Tanaka.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le mystérieux assassin (2)
programme.desc: Bien qu’Hiraoka ait fait chanter Ishimoto, c’est Takada qu’il a assassiné. Peut-être que ce dernier était la véritable cible et non pas Ishimoto… Se pourrait-il que Hiraoka ait été engagé juste pour faire office de meurtrier?

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre au théâtre (1)
programme.desc: Un charmant jeune homme débarque à l’école de Ran. Il dirige la deuxième génération de la troupe de théatre Tamanosuke. Tamanosuke invite Ran et Sonoko à assister aux répétitions et les deux jeunes filles acceptent.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre au théâtre (2)
programme.desc: “ITOE, je vais révéler ta véritable identité sur scène!” Voici le contenu du message écrit par Tamanosuke. Se pourrait-il qu’en essayant de le tuer, Itoe se soit retrouvé prise à son propre piège ?

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le 10ème braquage des hommes en noir
programme.sub-title: Le 10ème braquage des hommes en noir
programme.desc: Conan tombe par mégarde sur le braquage d’une banque. Les deux malfrats qui ont attaqué le vigile se sont enfui dans une voiture avec l’argent.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La nouvelle élève
programme.desc: Ai Haibara vient d'intégrer la classe de Conan. Au même moment, le frère aîné de leur camarade de classe disparaît. Alors qu'il mène l'enquête, Conan se dit que toute cette affaire est liée à un réseau de contrefaçons.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Menace de meurtre aveugle au stade (1)
programme.sub-title: Menace de meurtre aveugle au stade (1)
programme.desc: La voix du deuxième criminel résonne à nouveau dans le portable : « relachez mon complice et préparez l’argent avant la fin du match, sinon je tue un autre spectateur ».

programme.title: Détective Conan: Menace de meurtre aveugle au stade (2)
programme.sub-title: Menace de meurtre aveugle au stade (2)
programme.desc: Malgré les recherches fiévreuses de l'Inspecteur Megure et de ses hommes, le criminel reste introuvable. L'homme à l'allure suspecte qui avait attiré l'attention de Conan et de ses amis est en fait l'Inspecteur Takagi.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Magic Party (1)
programme.desc: La grande réunion des « amours magiques » se tient dans un châlet enneigé. Kogoro et Conan y déposent Ran et Sonoko. Sur le chemin du retour, une information passe à la radio qui les laisse sous le choc.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Magic Party (2)
programme.desc: Le cadavre de Hamano a été retrouvé dans l’arrière-cour, allongé dans la neige. L’absence de traces de pas tout autour laisse croire qu’un crime impossible vient d’être commis au châlet.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Magic Party (3)
programme.desc: C'est en observant un yacht représenté sur l'étiquette d'une bouteille de vin que Conan comprend pourquoi il a retrouvé des marques de carreaux d'arbalète dans l'arrière-cour.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre sans arme
programme.desc: Conan et ses amis visitent un salon de beauté lorsqu’ils assistent à une violente dispute entre Midori, le propriétaire, et l’esthéticienne Mika. Le lendemain, Mika est retrouvée morte.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le vieux château (1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ai, Ayumi, Genta et Mitsuhiko partent faire du camping avec le Dr Agasa et se perdent. Ils tombent alors sur un château de style occidental au beau milieu de la forêt.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le vieux château (2)
programme.desc: Le Docteur Agasa, Conan et notre Equipe de Détectives en Herbe sont invités à séjourner dans un château sur lequel ils sont tombés par hasard en rentrant de leur campement.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La dernière séance (1)
programme.desc: Le Dr Agasa remet à notre équipe de Détectives en Herbe de l’école primaire de Teitan des places de cinéma qu’il a gagné dans une tombola. Ils choisissent tous de s’y rendre le jour de l’anniversaire de l’école.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La dernière séance (2)
programme.desc: Hatta s’était endetté jusqu’au cou et pour l’Inspecteur Megure et les autres, c’est la raison qui l’aurait poussé au suicide.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Mission : sauver Ayumi
programme.desc: Conan et son Equipe de Détectives en Herbe parlent du cambriolage meurtrier qui s’est produit à l’Escargot, un restaurant français.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Intrigue nuptiale (1)
programme.desc: Heiji et Kazuha se rendent à Osaka afin d'assister au mariage de Kikuto Morizono. Conan, Ran et Kogoro les accompagnent et en profitent pour visiter le sanctuaire Meiji.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Intrigue nuptiale (2)
programme.desc: Shigematsu, le majordome, est assassiné dans la demeure des Morizono la veille du mariage entre Kikuto Morizono et Kaede Katigiri.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La nuit des étoiles
programme.desc: Conan, Ran et Sonoko se rendent à l'observatoire du Mont Hoshimi pour contempler le ciel étoilé. Ils y recontrent des étudiants en astronomie venus observer les corps célestes.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le meurtre de "l'étoile du Nord" (1)
programme.desc: Natsue Hatamoto invite Conan, Ran et Kogoro à Hokkaido à bord du North Star 3. Alors que Kogoro quitte son compartiment pour se promener dans le vestibule du train, il percute un homme avec des lunettes de soleil, coiffé d'un chapeau et portant un masque.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le meurtre de "l'étoile du Nord" (2)
programme.desc: Tetsurato Izumo, le propriétaire d'une bijouterie, a été abattu dans le North Star 3, un train de nuit, par Yasuji Asama. Ce dernier est parvenu à s'enfuir par une fenêtre mais on retrouvera son cadavre un peu plus tard.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'histoire d'amour d'un détective (1)
programme.desc: Conan et ses amis se rendent au commissariat afin de répondre à des questions au sujet d'une affaire déjà résolue. Une fois sur place, ils rencontrent l'inspectrice Takagi.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'histoire d'amour d'un détective (2)
programme.desc: Kayo, la femme de Keizo Masuo, le directeur d'une succursale de la Tohto Bank, a été assassinée à son domicile. L'Inspecteur Shiratori en a conclu que le coupable n'est autre que le braqueur de banque qui l'a retenue en otage.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'affaire du tramway
programme.desc: Alors qu'un étudiant grimpait à l'échelle pour photographier le tramway, celle-ci s'effondre. Il s'en sort indemne mais un cadavre est découvert par terre. L'inspecteur Wakai, du commissariat de Police de Harii, est persuadé qu'il s'agit d'un accident.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre au parc d'attractions
programme.desc: Kogoro emmène Conan et Ran à Nichiuri Land. Comme ils n'ont pas d'autre choix, ils assistent au spectacle de Kamen Yaiba. Le spectacle atteint son paroxysme lorsque Kamen Yaiba effectue son saut spécial à l'élastique depuis les tribunes.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre à la voiture piégée (1)
programme.desc: Lorsque Kogoro va rendre visite à Megumi, son ancienne élève particulière, il assiste à la mort de Hiromi, sa soeur cadette, victime de l'explosion de sa voiture.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Meurtre à la voiture piégée (2)
programme.desc: Conan passe la maison de Megumi au crible et déniche la preuve de sa culpabilité. Bien qu'il fasse part à Kogoro des conclusions permettant de l'incriminer, ce dernier n'arrive pas à le croire.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La disparition du vieil homme
programme.desc: Dans le bus, un homme âgé assis à côté de Ran se présente en affirmant qu'il vient justement de rencontrer son père. Il disparaît pourtant pendant que Ran est assoupie.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Dangereux été pour Sonoko (1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ran et Sonoko se rendent à Izu afin d'y passer leurs vacances. Masahiko Michiwaki, un étudiant de l'université de Beika, emmène Sonoko à un restaurant sur la plage.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Dangereux été pour Sonoko (2)
programme.desc: L'auberge de la plage d'Inzu est en proie à de nombreux incidents.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Un mystérieux suicide
programme.desc: Mitsue Muneta, la propriétaire de l'appartement que Kogoro occupait lorsqu'il était étudiant, vient lui demander conseil. Elle est inquiète car Makoto, son petit-fils, est déprimé. Kogoro emmène donc Ran et Conan dans le nouvel appartement.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'histoire d'amour d'un détective 2 (1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko et Ai répètent en secret la pièce qui sera jouée à l'école dans un bâtiment à l'abandon. C'est alors que Higashida, un prisonnier portant des menottes, se précipite à l'intérieur poursuivi par l'Inspectrice Sato.

programme.title: Détective Conan: L'histoire d'amour d'un détective 2 (2)
programme.desc: Conan et l'Inspecteur Takagi fouillent la chambre de Higashida et comprennent le stratagème concernant les deux chambres. ils en concluent que les épines de cactus retrouvées sur la véranda de Mlle Muranishi ont forcément été cassées par quelqu'un.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La ligne sans fin

programme.title: Détective Conan: La légende de la mystérieuse 5ème pagode (1)
programme.sub-title: La légende de la mystérieuse 5ème pagode (1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ran et Kogoro partent à Izu. Ils remarquent une pagode de 5 étages appartenant à un vieux temple.

programme.sub-title: La légende de la mystérieuse 5ème pagode (2)
programme.desc: Le temple est plongé en plein désarroi car les prêtres sont persuadés qu'ils ont affaire à une malédiction tandis que les forces de police penchent plutôt pour l'hypothèse du meurtre.

programme.sub-title: La mort arrive par les eaux
programme.desc: Conan, Ran et Kogoro vont dîner dans un restaurant très populaire. Leur dîner est pourtant interrompu par le meurtre de Keizo Kaneda, venu fêter sa promotion.

programme.desc: Conan et ses amis sont invités à la résidence d'été d'Agasa. Afin de respecter le testament qu'il a laissé après sa mort, 50 ans plus tôt, personne n'est entré dans la maison. Mais quelqu'un s'est introduit dans cette propriété fermée au public.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La lune, les étoiles et le soleil (2)
programme.sub-title: La lune, les étoiles et le soleil (2)
programme.desc: Conan et ses amis se lancent dans une chasse au trésor dans la résidence d'été d'Agasa. Ils découvrent un code secret que Conan parvient à résoudre et découvrent ensuite une chambre secrète.

programme.title: Détective Conan: La disparition du Club des détectives junior
programme.sub-title: La disparition du Club des détectives junior
programme.desc: Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko et Ayumi se rendent dans une auberge en pleine montagne. Ils décident d'y passer la nuit afin de répéter le spectacle de marionnettes pour le club d'enfants.

programme.title: Détective Conan: Le manoir de l'araignée (1)
