programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Ed release two cheetah brothers together, a symbol of their new partnership, but not all of the family are happy about this new start. Caroline is still furious at what she sees as Danny's betrayal of Du Plessis.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Ed are anxiously preparing for a review with JLW, the pharmaceutical company that fund their Endangered Species Project. They are desperate for it to go smoothly, and as a result are driving the rest of the family mad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's the grand reopening of Mara and a British wildlife charity is using the event to release a vulture back into the wild. Fatani, the new, young and ambitious manager of Mara has hired Danny as the vet to oversee the release.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is looking after a sick and orphaned baby elephant called Togo. However, despite Evan and Du Plessis' constant vigil, Togo is dying from a broken heart. Evan is distraught and Du Plessis promises they will look after her together.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Sarah's absence couldn't have come at a worse time for Leopard's Den. Nature Conservation is carrying out their annual inspection and everything has to be tip top. Danny's determined they pass with flying colours and everyone is roped in to help.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Everyone's excited at the prospect of Leopard's Den's new arrival. Bash, Danny's old tutor and Rosie's Godfather, is coming from England to help Danny grow his veterinary practice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Trevanions are delighted when Fatani asks Danny to take an aggressive hippo off his hands. As they prepare for its arrival Sarah gets a bit of a shock when her mother Caroline beats the hippo to the post.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Business is looking up at Leopard's Den but Sarah is feeling agitated. Caroline thinks it because Simon, her ex husband and Evan and Olivia's Dad, is arriving from England to get married. But Sarah has other things on her mind.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Du Plessis is in a foul mood. It's his 60th birthday and he has no intentions of celebrating it. But the Trevanions have other ideas and Caroline is organising a surprise party.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: All is quiet at Leopard's Den as Sarah, Evan and Olivia gather at the hospital. Danny has been given the all clear to go home. But Du Plessis is still unconscious and seriously ill. Caroline keeps a tender vigil at his bedside.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New lodges nearly break the family, but they learn that it's the animals which make Leopard's Den a success.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny needs an assistant but fails to see that she's right under his nose; Sarah finds out that she needs her mum.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den expands and DuPlessis becomes a grandfather after a close-call with an angry elephant.

programme.title: Acumuladores Compulsivos

programme.desc: Uma operação antidrogas em Oklahoma, uma overdose em Indiana e crianças em perigo no Texas.

programme.title: Quem Dá Mais?

programme.category: Temporada 15 Episódio 23 - Por que a Galinha Atravessou a Estrada?

programme.category: Temporada 15 Episódio 24 - Cinco Cartas e Nenhum Ás

programme.title: Humanidade: A História de Todos Nós

programme.title: Aqui Tem História

programme.title: Humanidade: A História de Todos Nós
programme.desc: Nos Andes, os espanhóis abrem a maior mina de prata do mundo e cunham milhões de pesos de "ocho", o dólar espanhol. Estas moedas transformam a economia global, enchem os baús dos piratas de tesouros, alimentam o auge do mercado de ações e ainda ajudam a pagar o Taj Mahal. Como um boom comercial, milhões de pessoas são trazidas para o Novo Mundo como escravos, mas muitos peregrinos também vêm como pioneiros, em busca de liberdade.

programme.title: A Chegada do Apocalipse
programme.desc: As profecias do povo hopi vêm sendo transmitidas de geração em geração e alertam sobre uma estrela azul que vai aparecer no céu, além de ocorrências de terremotos, tsunamis e vulcões que vão ameaçar a vida de milhões de pessoas.
programme.category: Temporada 1 Episódio 4 - Estrela Azul dos Índios Hopi

programme.title: Aqui Tem História

programme.title: A Chegada do Apocalipse

programme.desc: Durante os jogos que o Imperador Trajano realizou em 107 d.C., a multidão do Coliseu presenciou a entrada na arena de uma gladiadora, chamada Mévia, que entrou na arena para lutar após ter tido que renunciar ao seu status de cidadã livre de Roma.

programme.title: Legados da Antiguidade
programme.desc: Saiba como, no cerco de Massada, as forças romanas deslocaram três milhões de pés cúbicos de terra para mover uma montanha inteira. Conheça a tecnologia antiga que permitiu que os egípcios movessem obeliscos de mil toneladas, e os romanos transportassem pedras ainda mais pesadas nos templos em Baalbek.

programme.title: Construindo um Império
programme.desc: Peter Webber nos guia em uma viagem através da história de um dos impérios mais poderosos de todos os tempos: o Império Britânico. Ao longo dos séculos, seus governantes obtiveram conquistas inigualáveis por meio de sua grande tecnologia e engenharia, transformando a nação em um titã industrial.

programme.title: Construtores de Impérios
programme.desc: A dinastia Qing promoveu o Iluminismo chinês e deixou legados como a Cidade Proibida e o Templo do Céu. No entanto, no início do século XX, após as Guerras do Ópio e as rebeliões de Taiping e Boxer, a China sofreu o declínio e a dominação ocidental.

programme.title: Construtores de Impérios

programme.title: Asia
programme.sub-title: Secret Lives, Hidden Places - Great Gobi National Park: Mongolia - Following the Wild Camels
programme.desc: The Great Gobi Nationalpark in the southwest of Mongolia is home oft he most fascinationg mammals alive: the wild camels. The arcaic desert, impenetrable and misterious, ist he home of approximately 800 wild camels which are nearly extinct. The Gobi is one of the most sparsely populated areas around the world. We experience humans which live in the rough and misanthropic desert: Jangaa who breeds camels and specialises in camel polo Surendjav who owns a salt mine Erdene who built an oasis in the middle of the dessert.

programme.title: Asia
programme.sub-title: Secret Lives, Hidden Places - Pu Mat National Park: Vietnam - Of Bears and Men
programme.desc: The jungle in the north of Vietnam is nearly impenetrable and there are parts where no human has ever set foot on before. The rainforest oft he Pu Mat Nationalpark is a retreat for threatened animals like the Asian black bear, pangonlins or rare species of monkeys. Tuan, a biologist and specialist for bears, explores the untouched regions of the nationalpark to find the black bear. The animals which are hunted the most are Pangolins. It is believed that their scale has healing power and their meat is considered a delicacy. A small vietnamese animal protection organisation fights for the suvival of this species.

Weekly: "Jason Love is comedy that brings people together."From the Hollywood Improv to Carolines on Broadway, Jasons audience continues to grow. He has performed overseas for the troops and on the seas for cruise lines. Jason was a finalist at the Cabo Comedy Festival and at the World Series of Comedy in Vegas.Jasons non-profit, Love & Laughter, brings free shows to cancer support communities and others in need. His podcast is produced by Levity Entertainment. He is represented by Don Casino Productions.

Kellen has been a finalist of both the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and the Great American Comedy Festival. This year he performed at the prestigious Bridgetown Comedy Festival in Portland, Oregon. Kellen opens regularly for Frank Caliendo of FOX's NFL Sunday.

programme.title: Ron Ruhman
programme.desc: Ron has been called a “High Energy Seinfeld”. He brings a very energetic style to the stage as he shares his interesting slant on day-to-day life in an act that is clean, smart, and very entertaining.

programme.title: Kermit Apio
programme.sub-title: There's No I in Self Esteem
programme.desc: Born and raised in Honolulu, Hawaii, Kermet Apio enjoyed a childhood in paradise. He spent his time watching television, playing, and procrastinating everything else. To this day, he still does all three extensively. After graduating from high school, Kermet moved to Seattle to attend the University of Washington. Seattle became home. In early 1989, Kermet did his first open mike night at the Comedy Underground in Seattle. Comedy was a fun hobby. In May of 1990, he quit his job, said good bye to health care and benefits, and took the leap to performing full time. It is still his only job skill. He was the winner of the 2009 Great American Comedy Festival and has had numerous appearances on television and radio. He has showcased at comedy festivals in Aspen, Las Vegas, and Vancouver and has performed in 47 states and 3 Canadian provinces. He is a past winner of the Seattle Comedy Competition and was a semi-finalist in the San Francisco Comedy Competition. Also, in 1988 he was Dishwasher of the Month at the Sea-Tac Airport Dennyís. Kermet is married and the proud father of two wonderful children. He enjoys his family, baseball, and pie. He does not enjoy opera, sitting in traffic, and writing about himself in the third person.

programme.title: Keith Stubbs
programme.desc: Keith Stubbs is a 'triple threat' in showbiz and entertainment. He's a hilarious stand-up comedian, talented actor, and award-winning radio personality.Keith was twice voted 'Best Comedian' by City Weekly, the Standard-Examiner named him 'Funniest Comic' and he was a semi-finalist in Comedy Central's Laugh Riots comedy competition. The Utah-based comic has made television appearances on A&E's An Evening at the Improv, nationally syndicated Comedy.TV, ABC's America's Funniest People and has established himself as a funny, improvisational comic, host, roastmaster and emcee.Keith tours nationally and has shared the stage with showbiz legends Joan Rivers, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Cosby, Jim Gaffigan, Sinbad, Gladys Knight, and Frank Caliendo. Keith was one of five comedians who performed for the athletes in the Olympic Village at the 2002 Winter Games.Keith was named Best Actor by City Weekly for his show-stopping, comedic performance as 'Vinnie Black' in the stage production of Tony 'n Tina's Wedding. Stubbs currently plays Rob Schneider's accountant in the TV series "Real Rob" on Netflix.For eight consecutive years, Keith was awarded "Best Radio Personality" by the Utah Broadcasters' Association for his time spent as host of "The Stubbs Show" on 101.5 The Eagle. He also hosted KEITH STUBBS SPORTS on ESPN700 in Salt Lake City and appeared nationally on CMT radio and the Blue Collar Comedy channel on SiriusXM.Keith is often recognized for being a clean comedian, although his audiences span a broad spectrum. One review said, "Keith was funny, period! He was clean but we hardly noticed because his comedy and style are so unique and spot on."

programme.desc: Беременная женщина возвращается в дом у озера, где утонул её первенец. Чем ближе роды, тем твёрже её уверенность: он вернулся – и не хочет младшего брата. Режиссёр: Mara Fondacaro. Триллер, Италия

programme.title: Ghost Mountaineer
programme.desc: Группа эстонских студентов, отправившаяся в горы Сибири на поиски нефрита, оказывается отрезанной от мира после оползня. Когда один из участников исчезает и в группе разрастается паранойя, им приходится бороться и со стихией, и с психологическим ужасом. Режиссёр: Urmas E. Liiv. В ролях: Priit Pius, Reimo Sagor, Hanna Martinson. Ужасы, Эстония

programme.title: Best Friends
programme.desc: Отношения мужчины с лучшей подругой проходят проверку на прочность, когда она выходит замуж и ему приходится признаться себе в истинных чувствах. Многолетняя дружба Франческо и Клаудии осложняется, когда в неё вмешивается любовь, заставляя их задуматься о природе их связи. Режиссёр: Giovanni Veronesi. programme.title: Fraternity
programme.desc: Двое студентов, мечтающих попасть в элитное братство, участвуют во всё более опасных ритуалах посвящения. Режиссёр: Juan Gautier. В ролях: Lucas Nabor, Jorge Motos, Eduardo Rosa. Триллер, Испания

programme.title: The Final Shot
programme.desc: Получив в подарок старинный фотоаппарат, фотограф невольно открывает мрачную тайну: последний кадр на плёнке – снимок убитой женщины. Режиссёр: Arnaud Malherbe. В ролях: Jonathan Zaccaï, Armelle Deutsch, Francis Perrin. Боевик, Франция

programme.title: The Clinic
programme.desc: После аварии женщина, страдающая амнезией, оказывается в загадочной клинике на отдалённом острове. Очень скоро она начинает догадываться о её чудовищной сути. Режиссёр: Konstantinos Fragkoulis. В ролях: Maria Damasioti, Giorgos Kafetzopoulos, Korina Gougouli. Триллер, Греция

programme.title: Winning Ticket
programme.desc: Супруги выигрывают в лотерею и решают никому не рассказывать, но скрыть новое состояние оказывается куда труднее, чем они думали. Режиссёр: Lenka Hellstedt. Комедия, Финляндия

programme.title: Only You

Преподавательница физкультуры сталкивается с обвинениями и подозрениями всей деревни, а её собственное непростое прошлое лишь сгущает тайну. Режиссёр: Étienne Dhaene. В ролях: Ingrid Chauvin, Bruno Slagmulder, Thomas Cousseau. Комедия, Франция

programme.title: River of Fear

programme.title: Wild Heart
programme.desc: Пара перебирается в сельскую глушь, чтобы вдохнуть новую жизнь в свой брак, но у жены появляется искушение в лице обаятельного мастера на все руки. Влечение растёт, и ей приходится искать ответы на вопросы о верности и счастье, балансируя между реальностью и желанием. Режиссёр: Elisabeth Puglia. В ролях: Vincent Banic, Nienke Plas, Manuel Broekman. Триллер, Нидерланды

programme.desc: Leaphorn sospecha que todos los crímenes ocurridos en la reserva están relacionados. Leaphorn invita a cenar a Chee. Manuelito realiza un descubrimiento.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Mientras custodia a un sospechoso relevante, Leaphorn descubre que detrás de este crimen hay más de lo que hubiera imaginado. Manuelito se enfrenta a sus peores temores. Chee debe elegir entre su carrera y su pueblo.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn, Chee y Manuelito descienden al escondite de la Sociedad Búfalo. Allá dentro, se enfrentan a unas duras decisiones que podrían cambiar el resto de sus vidas.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: El policía tribal navajo Joe Leaphorn investiga la muerte de un hombre involucrado en una misteriosa secta, mientras Jim Chee, pluriempleado como detective privado, trabaja en su propio caso.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn profundiza en los vínculos personales que lo unen a un caso cada vez más enigmático. El sargento Manuelito interroga a Chee, aunque se muestra reticente a hacerlo. El hallazgo de un cadáver provoca que Leaphorn y Manuelito busquen a un niño.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Chee empieza a actuar por su propia cuenta tras el encuentro con un hombre peligroso. Leaphorn y Manuelito establecen una alianza con el sheriff del departamento, lo que le permite a Leaphorn encontrar una pista muy importante.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn pone en peligro su vida durante la persecución de un sospechoso. Manuelito desafía al sheriff con la intención de rescatar a su jefe. Chee reflexiona sobre una propuesta peligrosa que le ofrecerá respuestas sobre el caso.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn trabaja a contrarreloj para obtener una confesión de un sospechoso antes de que deje de estar bajo su custodia. Mientras tanto, Chee se introduce de incógnito en la secta que vincula sus distintas investigaciones.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee encuentran evidencias que vinculan sus casos, pero traen consigo una amarga verdad: será difícil que se haga justicia. Entretanto, Manuelito se prepara para un gran cambio en su vida.

programme.title: Dark Winds
programme.desc: Leaphorn y Chee buscan a un testigo tras el hallazgo de la bicicleta de un adolescente desaparecido. En la frontera, Manuelito encuentra a una madre y a su hijo conmocionados.

programme.title: Dark Winds

programme.title: Does Code-Switching Make You Less Latina? | Peligrosa HQ
programme.desc: We navigate the complexities of identity, and the various ways Latinas navigate their presentation across different environments. Gaby Ulloa joins us to help the Peligrosas reset the way they think about career changes.

programme.title: De Cocula Es El Mariachi | Hunters
programme.desc: El Mariachi es una de las representaciones más importantes de México en el mundo, viajamos a Cocula, cuna del Mariachi a conocer su origen, significado y demás tradiciones y leyendas que rodean a este hermoso pueblo mágico en Jalisco México.

programme.title: Capítulo I: Tlaltenco Es Comunidad | Hunters
programme.desc: A las orillas de CDMX y Estado de México existe un lugar con tradiciones llenas de colores identidad, Tlaltenco es conocido por sus fiestas patronales y bailes, trajes de charro con hilo de oro y plata y el gran festejo entre comparsas.

programme.title: Capítulo II: Tlaltenco Es Comunidad | Hunters
programme.desc: Segunda parte de Tlaltenco, donde la magia es representada entre mitos y leyendas, el festejo de coronación de la reyna que envuelve no sólo a los habitantes de esta comunidad atrayendo a turistas de todo el mundo.

programme.title: Imagen Awards & Carin León Controversy! | LatiNation Presents: Desmadre Live!

programme.desc: The viral SF Giants game video that had the entire internet calling this dad a "deadbeat". Gala Montes sets the record straight on her new era, and her upcoming album La Mala! Stand-up comedian Phil Medina drops by for some unhinged tour stories.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: El Ejecutor
programme.desc: Un asesino despiadado, entrenado para matar en nombre de Dios por un sacerdote corrupto, reevalúa el propósito de su vida después de salvar a un niño pequeño de uno de sus propios intentos de asesinato.

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: Mistrust

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Papi
programme.desc: Papi narra un día en la vida de Sonia, una niña de 8 años con una imaginación vibrante. Sus recuerdos y vuelos de fantasía surrealistas arrojan luz sobre su relación con su padre, conocido solo como el elusivo figura de "Papi". La joven soñadora Sonia enfrenta el dolor del abandono aferrándose a sus recuerdos de un héroe que aparece, pero nunca llega.

programme.title: Cualquier Cosa es Posible
programme.desc: Nathan, un niño prodigio, se escapa de casa después de descubrir que su madre está desaparecida en combate y que su padre no es su padre biológico.

programme.title: La Vendedora de Rosas
programme.desc: Mónica tiene 13 años y ya ha creado su propio mundo¸ en la calle¸ donde lucha con coraje para defender lo poco que tiene: sus amigas¸ su novio¸ que vende droga¸ y su dignidad y su orgullo que no le hace concesiones a nadie. En la noche de Navidad¸ como todas las noches¸ vende rosas para ganarse la vida. Pero la vida le depara una nueva cita con la soledad¸ la pobreza¸ la droga y la muerte.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales

programme.desc: In Portland, Maine a housewife disappears. One year later her body is unearthed in the cellar. I.R. unravels this cold case investigation from the inside out. With the help of science, police are able to uncover a blueprint of the crime.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When a schoolteacher is found murdered in her New Jersey apartment in the fall of 2009, suspicion is cast on her soon to be ex-husband. Long after the case goes cold, a detective embarks on a mission to help the man clear his name.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann? Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Bidh Latha na Cloinne ann a dh’aithghearr agus tha Peicein is a charaidean a’ cur romhpa tuairmsean a thoirt dham pàrantan a thaobh na preusantan a tha iad ag iarraidh. Ged nach eil iad a’ faighinn na bha iad ag iarraidh, tha iad ag iomlaid nam preusantan aca le chèile, is aig deireadh an latha tha iad a’ faighinn na bha iad ag iarraidh. Children’s Day is approaching, so Petit and his friends decide to give their parents clues on what gifts they want. Even though the youngsters don't receive their exact wishes, they end up exchanging presents to get what they all wanted.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ’S e latha air leth fliuch a th’ ann, is tha Àtaidh a’ lorg toll ann am mullach an taighe. An uair sin tha e a’ mothachadh gu bheil tuill ann an tòrr rudan san taigh aige. Tha e a’ co-dhùnadh toll a chladhach dha fhèin, ach tha e a' steigeadh ann! Ciamar a gheibh Tilidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich às e? It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it! How will Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs get him out?

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag a’ cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine. Mr Krabs makes Larry the Lobster temporary manager.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Chan eil an Tidsear Stiùiridh, Mgr Hobson, cinnteach gur e tàlant a th’ air cùlaibh na h-ealaine ach ma dh'fhaoidte trioblaid! Aig an aon àm, tha Mgr Mackle a’ dèanamh oidhirp a bhith nas fhallaine. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that’s behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, gheibh sinn a-mach mu chuid de na nithean neònach os-nàdarrach a tha tric a’ nochdadh ann am beul-aithris le teintean-biorach, caointichean agus tàcharain nam measg. The CBBC ALBA team brings us some of the scariest stories in Scottish history. In this episode, we delve into the paranormal with some of the strangest phenomena in Scottish folklore, including the will-o'-the-wisp, wailing women and changelings.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha taisbeanadh sgoile ri obrachadh air thairis air na saor-laithean – mu bheathaichean sgìreil, tron gheamhradh – tha Camshron ‘son na comharran às àird’ sa chlas fhaighinn, agus, mar as àbhaist, tha e ri foill! When there’s a school presentation to work on in the holidays, about regional animals during winter, Cameron wants the highest marks in the class and, as usual, he cheats!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Faodail: Beatha nan Eilean (Shorts)
programme.desc: Footage from the Faodail | Found Film Archive of the Outer Hebrides from the 1930s to the 1980s, charting growing up in the islands. The strong community ties of past generations still influence the islands today. Filmichean bho Thasglann Faodail | Found Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 1980an, a’ clàradh mar a bhathar a’ fàs suas sna h-eileanan. Tha ceanglaichean coimhearsnachd làidir nan ginealaichean a dh’fhalbh fhathast a’ toirt buaidh air na h-eileanan an-diugh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alive ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alive in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Kerrie is Ceitidh agus Beniamin is Calum a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo, a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Orain Oir
programme.desc: Taghadh às na tasglainn - seinneadairean Gàidhlig tro na bliadhnaichean. Archive performances of Gaelic song, through the decades.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Thig còmhla ri Packie Bonner, an seann glèidheadair aig Celtic, air ais air Bus Ghlaschu. Follow ex-Celtic goalkeeper Packie Bonner as he relives his journeys on the Glasgow bus.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Suidhichte taobh a-staigh Cearcall na h-Artaig, tha Eileanan Lofoten ann an Nirribhidh a’ tabhann luach fad-beatha de thoileachas don luchd-turais a bhitheas a’ tadhal ann. Air a tharraing leis an t-sreap agus an surfadh air leth a tha ri fhaotainn ann, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal timcheall nan eilean còmhla ri a chompanach, Calum Gibb, gus eòlas fhaighinn air an t-àite miorbhaileach seo. Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway’s Lofoten islands offer a lifetime’s worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean unique experiences.

programme.title: Greim-Bìdh le Gregor
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod takes fresh langoustines from a local fisherman to make paella, plus raspberry jam from an honesty box is used in a roly-poly.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024 le clàraidhean is còmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Genticorum, Pine Tree Flyers, Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Tim O’Brien & Jan Fabricius is Ceitidh Nicphàrlain. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Genticorum, Pine Tree Flyers, Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Tim O’Brien & Jan Fabricius and Katie Macfarlane. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Tha Daisy a’ faighinn leigheas èiginneach agus i a’ strì ri a h-anail a tharraing, fhad ’s a tha Treasa agus Ian a’ cur fàilte air na leth-aoin aca agus gan ullachadh fhèin airson Joshua a chall. Tha piseach a’ tighinn air Diane, agus thèid Méabh a ghluasad nas fhaisge air a dachaigh. Daisy receives emergency treatment for severe breathing problems, while Treasa and Ian welcome their twins and prepare to lose Joshua. Diane makes progress, and Méabh is transferred closer to home. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha stèisean tele eadar-lìon Fraochy Bay a' toirt duais do dh'aona dhuine bochd is iad a' leasachadh an taigh aige, gun fhiosta dha. Ach de a bhios a' feitheamh air Walter McSwain nuair a thilleas e dhachaidh? Fraochy Bay WebTV are doing it themselves. But will the lucky recipient Walter McSwain feel at home when it's time for the big reveal?

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha trèat sònraicht' aig Abigail, trèat ùr agus blasta de Fhritearan Mearag-bheag agus Peasair. Fèir ceart 'son a bhith air bòrd lòin air no bòrd bruinse, nuair a tha an teaghlach no caraidean ri tadhal. Abigail has a special treat in store in the form of fresh and tasty courgette and pea fritters. It's perfect for adding to that table top brunch or lunch spread when family or friends are visiting. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Tannadice '87
programme.desc: Tha 2017 a' comharrachadh an 30mh ceann-bliadhna bho rinn Dundee United FC rud a bha mòran dhaoine a' smaointinn a bha do-dheànta dhaibh: faighinn gu cuairt dheireannach Cupa UEFA. Tha Tannadice87 ag innse sgeulachd iongantach an iomairt Eòrpaich sin, bliadhna san do theab Dundè, a tha ainmeil airson silidh, diut agus naidheachdas, clach eile a chur air càrn urraim a' bhaile. 2017 marks the 30th anniversary of the year that Dundee United FC delivered on what many believed to be an impossible goal; reaching the final of the UEFA Cup. Tannadice '87 tells the remarkable story of this European adventure, a year in which dreams became reality, and Dundee, a city with a reputation for jam, jute and journalism added a fourth 'j' to its trademark: jubilation.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Plòigh na fèise ann an cuideachd Nile Rodgers & Chic agus iad a’ toirt ceòl disco is pop chun na Gàidhealtachd air Disathairne aig Belladrum 2022. A’ chuid as fheàrr den fhèis le Fiona NicChoinnich agus Niall Iain Dòmhnallach. All the fun of the festival from funk stars, Nile Rodgers & Chic. The musical heroes bring disco and pop to the Highlands as they rock the stage on Saturday at Belladrum, 2022. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald present the best of the festival.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus a charaidean bho’n oilthigh a’ deanamh air an t-slighe baidhsagal ainmeil Na Còig Aiseagan, le measgachadh spòrsail de dh’eòlasan, casan sgìth agus tòinean goirt! Somhairle and his university friends take on the infamous Five Ferries cycle route, with an entertaining mix of experience, resulting in tired legs and sore backsides!

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Às dèidh toiseach tòiseachaidh dùbhlanach, lean Somhairle agus Innes orra a’ rothaireachd air a Bhadger Divide, far an tàinig iad tarsainn air duilgheadasan meacanaigeach; uisge trom; geàrr-rathaidean; tionndadh ceàrr agus bagannan caillte! Thàinig an rothaiche agus an neach-gleidhidh chlàran, Kerry Nic a’Phì, còmhla riutha airson earrann. After a tough start, Somhairle and Innes continue riding the Badger Divide, where they encounter mechanical issues, torrential rain, shortcuts, wrong turns and lost baggage! They’re joined for a section by record-holder, cyclist Kerry MacPhee.

programme.title: Serie A (BBC Alba)
programme.desc: Ball-coise beò bho Serie A le Sassuolo a’ cur fàilte air Napoli. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le Ailig O’ Henley a’ preasantadh bho oir na pàirce agus aithris bho Micheal Steele. Football action from Serie A as Sassuolo welcome Napoli. Presented pitchside with Alex O’ Henley, while commentary comes from Micheal Steele.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Feumaidh an Dùd Beag a bhith far an urrainn dha bhith dùdach fad’ an là. Gu mì-fhortanach, chaidh e air seachran ach fhuair e a shlighe dhachaidh gu Planaid nan Dùd, le beagan taic bho a charaidean ùra Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he goes missing but finds his way back home to Planet Dùd, with a little help from his new friends.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha dùbhradh grèine ann an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha a’ Chearc Iarainn a’ dùbhradh an dùbhradh. Ciamar a gheibh iad air seo a rèiteachadh? There’s a solar eclipse happening today but, unfortunately, the Iron Chicken is eclipsing the event. How will they resolve this?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà ‘s e deargann a th’ ann am Fred ‘s chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g’ eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin! Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today’s playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha bràmair aig Bernie ‘s tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona ‘s Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i? Bernie has a girlfriend – and she’s on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing agus a charaidean a’ tarraing dealbh do Gilly, tha Teàrlaidh a' cur sgròb mhòr air feadh an deilbh aige-san ach tha Gilly a sealltainn dhaibh nach b' e droch rud a bh’ ann. When Bing and his friends draw a picture for Gilly, Charlie does a squiggle on Bing’s picture. But Gilly shows them that this is not such a bad thing.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig taigh Sula ’son Pàrtaidh Aodach-oichdh’, tha e a' gabhail feagal nuair a tha e a' cluinntinn meanglan mòr, sgrìobach bho muigh. Ach, an uairsin, tha e ag ionnsachadh nach eil rudan eagallach cho eagallach sa shaoileas tu. When Bing is at Sula’s house for a PJ Party, he gets frightened when he hears a large scratchy branch outside. At the end of the day though, he learns that things aren’t as scary as you think they are.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ fiathachadh a charaidean gu àite-obrach athar. Ach chan eil Dadaidh Pheicein a’ leigeil leotha suathadh ann an dad ach an t-ùrlar, is tha sin a’ fàs dòrainneach. Mu dheireadh thall, tha Dadaidh Pheicein a’ sealltainn dhaibh gun urrainn saorsainneachd a bhith air leth spòrsail. Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace. But his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha rudeigin dìomhair mun nighean ùr a th’ air an t-sràid – agus dè an gnothach a th’ aice ri trom-laighe Dhaibhidh? Tha Hilda airson a chuideachadh gus am faigh e seachad air an eagal a th’ air aig àm cadail. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh’s nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night time.

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a’ gabhail àite oir tha sinn a’ faicinn tanca, saighdearan a’ caismeachd agus…. geama leigeil-shaighdear? Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn’t the only thing that’s going on - there’s a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri brath fhaighinn air an fheadhainn eile, le bhith a’ cur an eagail orra leis a’ chruthachadh ‘eagallach’ aige, chan eil cùisean idir a’ dol leis. When Coinneach Clogaid tries to take advantage of the others by trying to frighten them with his 'scary' creation, things don’t quite go to plan.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha pàrantan Munchkin air earbs’ a chur ann, an cafaidh aca a ruith ’son a’ chiad turas, is chan eil e ’son fàiligeadh. Ri linn sin, tha Tabaidh is Flix ‘son a chuideachadh le obair-frithealaidh – ach saoil am bith iad feumail dha? Munchkin’s parents put their faith in him to run their cafe for the first time, and he doesn’t want to fail. As a result, Tabaidh and Flix want to help with serving, but will they be of any use?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp’, tha Denis a’ sealltainn dhaibh uile g’ eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach seachdainn le sgioba-naidheachd BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 72 air a sheinn le Kathleen Ghreumach, Criosda a-mhàin le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, bidh Criosaidh Màiri NicNèill ag innse mar a tha a creideamh air a bhith na chofhurtachd dhi aig àm trioblaidean teaghlaich, agus bidh Màiri Nic a' Ghobhainn a' leughadh à Ortha nan Gaidheal. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Kathleen Graham sings Psalm 72, and Calum Alex MacMillan sings Criosda a-mhàin. Chrissie Mary MacNeil tells how her faith has helped her deal with life-threatening illness in the family, and Mary Smith reads from Carmina Gadelica. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star. Ann a baile Appain tha Gregor MacCormaig a sealltainn na seann einseanean. Agus anns an Obain tha Captein Eric Mac’a Ghobhainn a ceilidh air am Pole Star ura. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress, turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie - Dileab a' Ghlinne
programme.desc: Dealas stàcair do dhachaigh a shinnsearan ann an Gleann Inbhir Làthail faisg air Ulapul. Local historian and deerstalker Duncan Mackenzie’s passion for Inverlael Glen, near Ullapool.

programme.title: Calum Cille: An Naomh Dana/Columba - The Bold Saint
programme.desc: He was at the centre of a bloody battle and founded a monastery that became a beacon of civilisation in the Early Middle Ages. But who was Colmcille, the Irish abbot also known as St Columba?

programme.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach/Dynamic Planet
programme.desc: As the ice drastically melts, we see how science, nature and tradition can prepare us for the future.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alive ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alive in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha iad uile a’ cruinneachadh san Achadh Fhiadhaich an-diugh airson òran mòr grinn a thoirt dhuin. Everyone is gathering in Achadh Fhiadhaich today to sing a big, lovely song.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona ‘s Baba a’ faicinn ceàrdalan – creutair beag iongantach a tha air misean cudromach ‘s e feuchainn ri ball-buachair fhaighinn dhachaigh! Ged a tha an ceàrdalan èasgaidh, tha cnapan-starra gu leòr na aghaidh ‘s beagan cuideachaidh a dhith. Oona and Baba have spotted a dung beetle – a special little creature on an important mission to roll his dung ball back to the nest! The beetle is highly skilled, but there are many obstacles in his way and he may need help from some friends.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mama air a sgiath a ghoirteachadh ‘s chan fhaigh i dhol a dh’iasgach. Tha Oona airson Papa a chuideachadh na h-àite ach, le gaoth làidir a' sèideadh ‘s faoileagan a’ bagairt, feumaidh Oona a bhith fìor thapaidh! Mama has hurt her wing and cannot join Papa on today’s fishing trip. Oona is determined that she will help Papa instead but, between strong winds and menacing seagulls, Oona will need to show just how brave she can be!

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Fuigheag mì-shona nuair a tha rola de theip steigeadh a' steigeadh ris. Feumaidh Boban Fuigheag a shocrachadh, mus fhàs cùisean nas miosa, 's gum iad steigte ri chèile? Ach le suathadh is caidirean gaolach, tha a h-uile sìon foirfe! Fuigheag is not happy when a roll of tape sticks to him. Boban must try to calm him down before things get worse, and they end up stuck together. But with a little loving cuddle, everything is fine!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp is Bran a’ dèanamh geamannan à stràbhan is biadh sa ghàrradh. After a garden barbecue, Ziff, Pipp and Button turn straws and snacks into agility games!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Comhachag air dealbh a tharraing airson pàirt a ghabhail ann am farpais ach, chan eil e an dùil gu bheil e math gu leòr ’s tha e ga chaith air falbh. Ge-tà, tha Sionnach ga lorg, agus tha e fhèin is Maigheach a’ cur an dealbh dhan fharpais gun fhiosta do Chomhachag. Leis a sin chan e briseadh dùil a bhios ann mur a buannaich e. Feumaidh iad seo uile a chumail dìomhair gus am faigh iad fios air ais. Abair dùbhlan! Owl wants to enter a drawing contest, but fearing his work is not good enough, he throws it away. Fox brings the discarded drawing to Hare and they decide to send it in secretly. This way Owl won't be disappointed if he doesn't win. They just need to keep it a secret until the news arrives. But this proves to be a big challenge.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Tha Pompon a' dèanamh a dhìcheall cùisean a rèiteach do Rita le bhith cruthachadh grioglachan racun dhith-se. Ach tha Rita doirbh a sàsachadh. Pompon does his utmost to create a constellation that reflects Rita's name and character. But Rita is hard to please.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ leughadh Heidi am Falach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Fiona Woodcock agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Eilidh Cormack reads Heidi am Falach, written and illustrated by Fiona Woodcock and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Patrick leads a stranger around Bikini Bottom. Tha Pàdraig a’ toirt coigreach air chuairt ann am Bonn Bicini.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha Mgr Mackle fo uallach agus chan eil e a’ faighinn fois an àite sam bith. Tha Ms Dallas air a dòigh glan gu bheil An Còirneal Cliseam a' tadhal air an sgoil airson clas air leth a theagaisg. Mr Mackle is under pressure and he can't seem to get any respite. Ms Dallas is delighted that Colonel Clisham is visiting the school to teach a camouflage class.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Flix, an aon chù am measg chat! An dùil a bheil sàr chùmhachd aige? Ge brith dè th’ ann, feumaidh e oidhirp a dhèanamh ’son faighinn a-mach dè a th’ ann! Flix, one dog in a cat’s world! Do you think he has a superpower? Whatever it is, he has to try to find out!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Troig ’son sealltainn do na Gumbalan eile gum bi deagh bheachdan aige. Chan eil sin follaiseach an dèidh dha tighinn tarsainn air an inneal glacaidh chnuimh aig Gubbo. Troig wants to show the other Gumbals that he has good ideas. However, this is not the case once he comes across Gubbo’s grub grabbing machine.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Troig air misean teasairginn air Cnoc nam Bògais, tha aige ri bhith seòlta gus am faigh e air Gumbalan a shaoradh. Tha plan aige – is fàisneachdan cuideachd! When Troig is on a rescue mission on Cnoc nam Bògais, he has to be cunning so that he can free some Gumbals. He has a plan, and some prophecies, too!

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Continuing a journey throughout Scotland to discover the historic and contemporary hand-crafted practices behind artisan producers of woven fabrics. These include wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather, and many more unorthodox fabrics. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Calum Maclean is in Glasgow taking a step back in time along the banks of the River Clyde. We also meet learners Audrey and Davy Paterson from Taynuilt.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnhallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha Joshua is Lewis, agus Anna is Eve. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions. Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize are Joshua and Lewis, and Anna and Eve. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eòrpa
programme.desc: Eòrpa reports on some of the most important issues from Scotland and across Europe.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Tha Cass Ezeji a’ coinneachadh ri daoine a th’ anns na ficheadan. Cass Ezeji meets people in their 20s.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: Murdina is thrown into turmoil when she realises that Johan is becoming a majority shareholder in the mill. Manager Sìleas offers newcomer Rory a job as one of the drivers. But just who exactly is this mysterious Irish stranger, Rory? Ivor and Dòmhnall’s relationship is put to the test when Ivor shares his fears that he may be responsible for the fire. Tha Murdina troimhe-chèile nuair a tha i ag ionnsachadh gur ann aig Johan a bhios an roinn as motha ‘sa mhuileann. Tha Sìleas, ceannard na muilne, a’ toirt obair do Rory mar dhraibhear, ‘s e air ùr nochdadh. Ach cò dìreach a th’ anns a’ choigreach Èireannach, Rory? Tha buaireadh eadar Ivor is Dòmhnall, le Ivor ag aideachadh gur dòcha gur esan as coireach airson an teine. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Leth-cheud bliadhna às deidh deireadh Cogadh, tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus faighinn a-mach mar a tha an cogadh agus sgaradh na dùthcha fhathast a’ toirt buaidh air daoine ann am Bhietnam an-diugh. Tro thuras, chì Ramsay seann shaighdearan bhon dà thaobh a tha a’ tighinn aghaidh ri aghaidh airson a’ chiad uair bho thàinig an cogadh gu crìoch. Thèid e a-mach còmhla ri sgiobaidhean a tha ag obair gus bomaichean is mèinnean nach deach an spreadhadh a thoirt às an talamh; agus cluinnidh e sgeulachdan mu dhaoine a tha fhathast beò le buaidh cogadh le stuthan ceimigeach. Half a century after the end of the Vietnam War and the country's reunification, Ramsay MacMahon embarks on a journey to discover how war and division continue to affect people in Vietnam today. During his journey, Ramsay meets former soldiers from both sides who come face to face with each other for the first time since the war ended. He joins teams working to clear unexploded ordnance from the ground; and he hears the stories of people still living with the consequences of chemical warfare. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Davis v Taylor: The '85 Black Ball Final
programme.desc: A look back at one of British sport's golden moments - the 1985 World Championship Snooker final. At its peak, over 18 and a half million people sat glued to their sets as Steve Davis and Dennis Taylor battled past midnight to a final and deciding black ball, BBC Two's biggest ever audience. Colin Murray journeys around the UK filling in the gaps on the first time that he was allowed to see the other side of midnight. Along the way he finds answers to questions such as where did Dennis's 'upside-down glasses' actually come from? What really went on behind those dressing room doors? How did you spread the news in a world without mobile phones? And how different would the lives of the two protagonists have been if the result had been reversed that night? Featuring contributions from Barry McGuigan, Ted Lowe, Stephen Hendry and Barry Hearn.

programme.desc: Filmed live at the Barbican in London, this major production of the classic musical comedy features an all-star cast led by renowned Broadway actress Sutton Foster, reprising her Tony-winning performance as Reno Sweeney, alongside the award-winning Robert Lindsay and Felicity Kendal, as well as beloved West End legend Gary Wilmot. A heart-warming romance, featuring spectacular dance routines and some of theatre’s most memorable songs. When the SS American heads out to sea, etiquette and convention head out of the portholes as two unlikely pairs set off on the course to true love - proving that sometimes destiny needs a little help from a crew of singing sailors, a comical disguise and some good old-fashioned blackmail. This hilarious musical romp across the Atlantic, directed by the multi-award-winning Broadway director and choreographer Kathleen Marshall, features Cole Porter’s joyful score, including I Get a Kick Out of You, You’re the Top and the show-stopping Anything Goes.

programme.title: South Pacific in London
programme.desc: A programme from 1986 that follows the production of a new recording of the music from South Pacific, the Richard Rodgers and Oscar Hammerstein musical that boasts many of their best and most enduring numbers. Television cameras were at the Henry Wood Hall in London to watch the classic musical given a new lease of life by José Carreras, Kiri Te Kanawa, Sarah Vaughan and Mandy Patinkin.

programme.title: The Truth about Christmas Carols
programme.desc: There could be nothing more sweet and sentimental than the sound of traditional carols performed by a velvet-voiced choir at Christmas. Or so you would think. Composer Howard Goodall uncovers the surprising and often secret history of the Christmas carol. Far from being accepted as part of the celebrations of Jesus's birth, over the centuries carols have been banned by both church and state. The carols we sing seem set in stone, and yet they can have up to 400 regional variations. Individual carols have caused controversy - While Shepherds Watched had to be cleaned up by the Victorians for being too crude, and there's a suspicion that O Come All Ye Faithful was a call to 18th-century Jacobites to rebel. The documentary celebrates the enduring power of the carol with a variety of performances from folk singer Bella Hardy to the choir of Truro Cathedral.

programme.title: Being the Brontës
programme.desc: Martha Kearney, novelist Helen Oyeyemi and journalist Lucy Mangan travel to Haworth Parsonage, the home of Charlotte Brontë and her sisters, Emily and Anne, to discover the inspiration behind their classic novels Jane Eyre, Wuthering Heights and Agnes Grey. Just two years before the books were published, prospects for the three unmarried sisters were bleak. Their brother was battling alcoholism, Charlotte was hopelessly in love with a married man, and their father was going blind. But by 1848, they were a literary sensation. To find out how this extraordinary turnaround happened, Martha, Lucy and Helen each immerse themselves in the life of a Brontë sister. From everyday routines at the Parsonage to walks on windswept moors, from harsh schooldays to misadventures as governesses, the trio learn how the Brontës combined literary genius with real-life experience to create some of the best-loved novels in the English language.

programme.title: Pompeii: The Mystery of the People Frozen in Time
programme.desc: The city of Pompeii uniquely captures the public's imagination - in AD79 a legendary volcanic disaster left its citizens preserved in ashes to this very day. Yet no-one has been able to unravel the full story that is at the heart of our fascination - how did those bodies become frozen in time? For the first time, the BBC has been granted unique access to these strange, ghost-like body casts that populate the ruins and, using the latest forensic technology, the chance to peer beneath the surface of the plaster in order to rebuild the faces of two of the people who were killed in this terrible tragedy. Margaret Mountford turns detective to tell a new story at the heart of one of history's most iconic moments, as she looks at the unique set of circumstances that led to the remarkable preservation of the people of Pompeii. By applying modern-day forensic analysis to this age-old mystery, Margaret dispels the myths surrounding the events in AD79. She also explores the lives of the individuals who once lived in this vibrant and enigmatic city and recreates the last moments of the people caught up in this tragedy.

programme.title: This Green and Pleasant Land: The Story of British Landscape Painting
programme.desc: Four hundred years of art history in 90 minutes? This film takes an eclectic group of people from all walks of life, including artists, critics and academics, out into the countryside to take a look at how we have depicted our landscape in art, discovering how the genre carried British painting to its highest eminence and won a place in the nation's heart. From Flemish beginnings in the court of Charles I to the digital thumbstrokes of David Hockney's iPad, the paintings reveal as much about the nation's past as they do the patrons and artists who created them. Famous names sit alongside lesser-known works, covering everything from the refined sensibilities of 18th-century classicism to the abstract forms of the war-torn 20th century with a bit of love, loss, rivalry and rioting thrown in. Contributions come from a cast as diverse as the works themselves, including film-maker Nic Roeg, historian Dan Snow and novelist Will Self, who offer a refreshingly wide range of perspectives on a genre of art which we have made very much our own.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor visit RSPB Freiston Shore in Lincolnshire to see an ambitious engineering project being unveiled - a saline lagoon created to provide an ecologically important habitat alongside the Wash. Matt meets the team behind the project to discover how they turned a 17-acre site into a highly engineered coastal lagoon, creating vital nesting sites for migratory birds. He also peers beneath the surface to see what saline specialists have already colonised in this new habitat. Margherita joins the volunteers preparing the lagoon’s nesting sites ahead of the spring breeding season, while Adam Henson is in Belfast for the BBC Food and Farming Awards to reveal Countryfile’s Young Countryside Champion 2026.

programme.title: Heal with the Princess of Wales
programme.desc: Introduced by Kirsty Young. Acquired for the BBC, the princess’s deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Across the north of England, police close in on an organised crime gang targeting farms and stealing hi-tech GPS systems worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. After months of painstaking detective work, coordination across multiple forces and help from farmers on the ground, a high-stakes sting operation is launched to bring the thieves to justice. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates a family-run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. Firefighters battle through the night to bring the blaze under control. And in Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus as she is reunited with the air ambulance team who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A Southport Victorian villa provides a blank canvas for a six-figure development project, while in South Shields there's a much smaller budget for an already pristine maisonette. In Folkestone, a father and daughter set to work creating a smart HMO.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: For half a century, a well-known British company has been bringing clay to life, creating iconic TV and movie characters. Founded by Peter Lord and David Sproxton, Aardman are the Bristol-based animators behind Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep. Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: In this episode, a cryptocurrency special, the team track and confront various groups of scammers, all operating within the world of cryptocurrency. As they try to speak to victims, a heartbreaking email from one person previously defrauded strengthens the team’s resolve to hold these scammers to account. Finally, Nick and Rav attempt to confront some of the scammers themselves and disrupt their office in Georgia as much as possible.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives

It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Across the north of England, police close in on an organised crime gang targeting farms and stealing hi-tech GPS systems worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. After months of painstaking detective work, coordination across multiple forces and help from farmers on the ground, a high-stakes sting operation is launched to bring the thieves to justice. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates a family-run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. Firefighters battle through the night to bring the blaze under control. And in Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus as she is reunited with the air ambulance team who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A Southport Victorian villa provides a blank canvas for a six-figure development project, while in South Shields there's a much smaller budget for an already pristine maisonette. In Folkestone, a father and daughter set to work creating a smart HMO.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: For half a century, a well-known British company has been bringing clay to life, creating iconic TV and movie characters. Founded by Peter Lord and David Sproxton, Aardman are the Bristol-based animators behind Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep. Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: In this episode, a cryptocurrency special, the team track and confront various groups of scammers, all operating within the world of cryptocurrency. As they try to speak to victims, a heartbreaking email from one person previously defrauded strengthens the team’s resolve to hold these scammers to account. Finally, Nick and Rav attempt to confront some of the scammers themselves and disrupt their office in Georgia as much as possible.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright meets a street of doorbell detectives from Northampton, whose super sleuthing didn’t just crack one case but two! programme.title: Escape to the Country

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: As Nigella says, 'Part of the balance of life lies in understanding that different days require different types of eating'. So in this episode, Nigella shares her favourite menu to help get that balance in the kitchen. For the days when something light and luscious is needed, Nigella's salad of salmon, avocado, watercress and pumpkin seeds fits perfectly. For the occasions that call for something a bit different, there is Nigella's chicken shawarma with an array of spices, sauces and flatbreads. Inspired by a spit-roasted Lebanese kebab, Nigella's oven-roasted version is fun, tasty and prefect for feeding a crowd. There has to be chocolate in the balance and Nigella shares two of her latest treats - a glossy liquorice and blackcurrant chocolate cake and her chocolate chip cookie dough pots - freshly baked pots of gooey cookie dough served with a dollop of ice cream or creme fraiche.

As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. programme.title: Bargain Hunt

It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Across the north of England, police close in on an organised crime gang targeting farms and stealing hi-tech GPS systems worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. After months of painstaking detective work, coordination across multiple forces and help from farmers on the ground, a high-stakes sting operation is launched to bring the thieves to justice. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates a family-run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. Firefighters battle through the night to bring the blaze under control. And in Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus as she is reunited with the air ambulance team who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A Southport Victorian villa provides a blank canvas for a six-figure development project, while in South Shields there's a much smaller budget for an already pristine maisonette. In Folkestone, a father and daughter set to work creating a smart HMO.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: For half a century, a well-known British company has been bringing clay to life, creating iconic TV and movie characters. Founded by Peter Lord and David Sproxton, Aardman are the Bristol-based animators behind Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep. Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: In this episode, a cryptocurrency special, the team track and confront various groups of scammers, all operating within the world of cryptocurrency. As they try to speak to victims, a heartbreaking email from one person previously defrauded strengthens the team’s resolve to hold these scammers to account. Finally, Nick and Rav attempt to confront some of the scammers themselves and disrupt their office in Georgia as much as possible.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright meets a street of doorbell detectives from Northampton, whose super sleuthing didn’t just crack one case but two! programme.title: Escape to the Country

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: As Nigella says, 'Part of the balance of life lies in understanding that different days require different types of eating'. So in this episode, Nigella shares her favourite menu to help get that balance in the kitchen. For the days when something light and luscious is needed, Nigella's salad of salmon, avocado, watercress and pumpkin seeds fits perfectly. For the occasions that call for something a bit different, there is Nigella's chicken shawarma with an array of spices, sauces and flatbreads. Inspired by a spit-roasted Lebanese kebab, Nigella's oven-roasted version is fun, tasty and prefect for feeding a crowd. There has to be chocolate in the balance and Nigella shares two of her latest treats - a glossy liquorice and blackcurrant chocolate cake and her chocolate chip cookie dough pots - freshly baked pots of gooey cookie dough served with a dollop of ice cream or creme fraiche.

After months of painstaking detective work, coordination across multiple forces and help from farmers on the ground, a high-stakes sting operation is launched to bring the thieves to justice. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates a family-run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock.
