And in Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus as she is reunited with the air ambulance team who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: For half a century, a well-known British company has been bringing clay to life, creating iconic TV and movie characters. Founded by Peter Lord and David Sproxton, Aardman are the Bristol-based animators behind Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep. Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

Derek's guide is Will Renwick, who at 22 became the youngest person to walk the whole perimeter of Wales. The walk is gentler but takes in extraordinary burial chambers, a pretty church and some dazzling dahlias at the recently restored Dyffryn Gardens.

Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor visit RSPB Freiston Shore in Lincolnshire to see an ambitious engineering project being unveiled - a saline lagoon created to provide an ecologically important habitat alongside the Wash. Matt meets the team behind the project to discover how they turned a 17-acre site into a highly engineered coastal lagoon, creating vital nesting sites for migratory birds. He also peers beneath the surface to see what saline specialists have already colonised in this new habitat. Margherita joins the volunteers preparing the lagoon’s nesting sites ahead of the spring breeding season, while Adam Henson is in Belfast for the BBC Food and Farming Awards to reveal Countryfile’s Young Countryside Champion 2026.

programme.title: Heal with the Princess of Wales
programme.desc: Introduced by Kirsty Young. Acquired for the BBC, the princess’s deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor visit RSPB Freiston Shore in Lincolnshire to see an ambitious engineering project being unveiled - a saline lagoon created to provide an ecologically important habitat alongside the Wash. Matt meets the team behind the project to discover how they turned a 17-acre site into a highly engineered coastal lagoon, creating vital nesting sites for migratory birds. He also peers beneath the surface to see what saline specialists have already colonised in this new habitat. Margherita joins the volunteers preparing the lagoon’s nesting sites ahead of the spring breeding season, while Adam Henson is in Belfast for the BBC Food and Farming Awards to reveal Countryfile’s Young Countryside Champion 2026.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The roadshow pays a final visit to Swanage Pier in Dorset, where treasures include shipwreck finds, a jewel-encrusted bird and an early folding bike.

programme.title: Heal with the Princess of Wales
programme.desc: Introduced by Kirsty Young. Acquired for the BBC, the princess’s deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing
programme.desc: The results of the latest public vote are revealed as our remaining couples find out if they have made it to the final theme week of the series, musicals. The professionals take to the dance floor for a spectacular group number, and the judges break down all the action from the previous night. Two couples battle it out in the latest dance-off, with only one advancing through to next week. Who will miss out on a place in the quarter-final?

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: A journey into the last great frontier on earth: the deep. It was once considered empty, but now, thanks to new technology, we know life thrives there in astonishing abundance.

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: Liz and Jonathan worry that the second spirit has attached itself to them. Liz learns that a man called Thomas Edwards was murdered at Heol Fanog in 1898. The Rev Huw Williams returns to bless the house and put Thomas’s spirit to rest, while Liz meets Colin, the grandson of Thomas Edwards. Bill tries to escape Heol Fanog.

Plus music from singer-songwriter Sienna Spiro, performing Pure.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Across the north of England, police close in on an organised crime gang targeting farms and stealing hi-tech GPS systems worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. After months of painstaking detective work, coordination across multiple forces and help from farmers on the ground, a high-stakes sting operation is launched to bring the thieves to justice. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates a family-run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the fire ignites, owner Deborah watches helplessly from her hospital bed, and husband Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. Firefighters battle through the night to bring the blaze under control. And in Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus as she is reunited with the air ambulance team who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A Southport Victorian villa provides a blank canvas for a six-figure development project, while in South Shields there's a much smaller budget for an already pristine maisonette. In Folkestone, a father and daughter set to work creating a smart HMO.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: For half a century, a well-known British company has been bringing clay to life, creating iconic TV and movie characters. Founded by Peter Lord and David Sproxton, Aardman are the Bristol-based animators behind Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep. Christina Trevanion visits its headquarters to celebrate their 50th anniversary and learn about their ‘cracking’ creations. Meanwhile, two teams of antiques hunters get animated as they dash around Ardingly fair in West Sussex. With antiques expert Izzie Balmer is married couple Halleh and Frios, and with expert Nick Hall are partners Bexley and Rebecca. The reds spot a decorative vase, but Izzie is put off by the damage. Across the fair, Bexley takes a shine to a concrete lizard that reminds him of a species found in teammate Rebecca’s home country of New Zealand. Will it slither to a profit at Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire? Or will the blues come out on top?

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: In this episode, a cryptocurrency special, the team track and confront various groups of scammers, all operating within the world of cryptocurrency. As they try to speak to victims, a heartbreaking email from one person previously defrauded strengthens the team’s resolve to hold these scammers to account. programme.title: Doorbell Detectives

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: Jamie McGregor and the passionate community helping to revive Scotland’s ancient tradition of stone lifting. Once used as a test of strength, stone lifting is being reimagined for modern Scotland. Open to everyone – women and men, seasoned athletes and complete beginners alike – it has become a small but fiercely supportive community. The challenge is physical, but the reward is deeply emotional. One of the country’s most experienced stone lifters, Jamie is a prison officer, former Strongman competitor and tireless advocate for the sport. During a packed few months, he heads out on stone-lifting tours through Perthshire and Iceland, places a new lifting stone on an ancient Highland coffin road, celebrates his 50th birthday, and prepares to marry his fiancee Gail – affectionately known as his 'stone wife' – who has supported him throughout his stone-lifting journey. Along the way, we meet the fun and colourful characters who make up this close-knit 'stone family'. A warm and uplifting portrait of strength, community and heritage, this documentary explores how an ancient test of power is finding new life in the modern world.

With local guides stepping in after the loss of his guide dog Major, Ian discovers St Andrews in their company.

programme.desc: When Eric and Beth put their tree up earlier than usual, they unwittingly kick off the Christmas season in Latimer Crescent. What starts as a simple decoration quickly turns into a flurry of festive activity as neighbours start to gear up for the holidays in their own unique ways. Colin and Cathy find themselves pondering the perfect gifts for each other, while Ian and Gordon plan for a quieter, scaled-back Christmas. Meanwhile, Alan and Michelle wrestle with transport issues that threaten to derail their festive plans, and Christine is busy arranging a very special trip, ensuring that the season is full of surprises, laughter and the kind of neighbourly chaos that only Latimer Crescent can provide.

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: Following a cabinet reshuffle, Zander McGurk breezes into a new job with big plans for Scotland's police operation. The straight-talking go-getter promises the Chief a bigger budget so long as he trims the fat from his force. Miekelson vows to step up and act as the Ozempic of spending. However, he soon discovers that getting with McGurk's programme means ditching the department of DEI. If the Chief signs that Faustian pact, can he live with his conscience and the judgy comments of his daughter's book group?

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: Jamie McGregor and the passionate community helping to revive Scotland’s ancient tradition of stone lifting. Once used as a test of strength, stone lifting is being reimagined for modern Scotland. Open to everyone – women and men, seasoned athletes and complete beginners alike – it has become a small but fiercely supportive community. The challenge is physical, but the reward is deeply emotional. One of the country’s most experienced stone lifters, Jamie is a prison officer, former Strongman competitor and tireless advocate for the sport. During a packed few months, he heads out on stone-lifting tours through Perthshire and Iceland, places a new lifting stone on an ancient Highland coffin road, celebrates his 50th birthday, and prepares to marry his fiancee Gail – affectionately known as his 'stone wife' – who has supported him throughout his stone-lifting journey. Along the way, we meet the fun and colourful characters who make up this close-knit 'stone family'. A warm and uplifting portrait of strength, community and heritage, this documentary explores how an ancient test of power is finding new life in the modern world.

Megalodon is determined to get a transfer to Mobeen’s wing so he can confront him about meddling in his business. Mobeen and Nate also have to deal with prison officer Saj, who is a constant thorn in their side. Alongside all this, Mobeen gets a visit from Aqsa, who is getting frustrated with certain aspects of life at medical school. Mobeen also pays a visit to the prison’s multifaith chaplain, who is a familiar figure, and another old face has a mission for Mobeen that could throw him back into a whole world of trouble - but will he take it on?

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen

In the infirmary, he also encounters a doctor, Nida, and there’s an instant spark between her and Mobeen. Nida also suggests she can help Aqsa with a placement for her medical degree, which she is thrilled with. Aqsa also receives some characteristically unhelpful advice from prison chaplain Uncle Shady. While Mobeen is in the hospital, Nate and Officer Harper develop a bromance that makes Mobeen jealous. Meanwhile, Megalodon is still trying to get transferred to Mobeen’s wing...

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: Megalodon is now on Mobeen’s wing, and Mobeen must avoid him at all costs – which means trying not to leave his cell. Harper instantly makes Mobeen leave the cell to go and see Dr Nida. Nida now has Aqsa working alongside her, and has even managed to secure her an international placement in the UAE. But despite avoiding Megalodon, Harper and Mobeen fail to get any more information about Memory Stick. Later that night, Harper goes to Mobeen’s cell, only to find out he’s slipped out to see Dr Nida in her office. Mobeen is caught red-handed by a furious Harper and Nate. Things take a turn when Mobeen hears that an inmate and friend Jamal needs his help. Despite the danger that leaving the cell puts him in, Mobeen goes to see Jamal... only to encounter Megalodon on the way.

programme.title: Man Like Mobeen
programme.desc: Megalodon throws the prison into a full-blown riot. Mobeen, Nate and Harper split off into different groups. Mobeen is concerned with Dr Nida’s safety, while also keen to keep Memory Stick on side. Uncle Shady ends up with Memory Stick, with both of them desperately trying to evade Megalodon and a wing full of rioting inmates. Eventually, our heroes are all reunited and wait for the arrival of the Tornado Team, a special unit trained to deal with riots. But before the Tornado Team arrive, Mobeen ends up in a climactic showdown with Megalodon, where a whole catalogue of revelations emerge. Can Mobeen and Nate survive and leave as free men, or will trouble finally catch up with them once and for all?

programme.title: Charlie Cooper’s Myth Country
programme.desc: Charlie Cooper, who wrote and starred in the BBC’s This Country, has a fascination for the weird and wonderful world of British folklore. In this episode, with the help of an old AA van, he goes in search of Black Shuck, the demon dog of East Anglia. Despite a local legend that seeing Shuck brings with it a curse, Charlie meets locals who claim they have survived such encounters. Keen to capture the beast on camera, he attempts an overnight stakeout, with unexpected consequences. Alleged sightings of this 900-year-old hell hound are recorded almost monthly, so is Charlie in with a chance? His humorous odyssey takes him across Norfolk and Suffolk, where he meets witnesses and learns that in Britain almost every county has its own mythical creature. You only need to scratch the surface anywhere in this land to discover that folklore, myth and legend are very much alive.

programme.title: Charlie Cooper’s Myth Country
programme.desc: Charlie Cooper’s odyssey takes him to Wiltshire, home to ancient sites such as Stonehenge, Avebury and the Westbury chalk horse. He wants to get to the bottom of why humans feel the need to leave marks on the landscape. He soon turns his investigation towards a far more recent phenomenon, crop circles, hoping to settle a debate that has plagued his family for years. They believe that crop circles are the work of aliens, but Charlie strongly doubts that. He meets with farmers and secretive 'croppies' (humans who create crop circles), trying to find out how these vast and intricate shapes appear overnight. Helped by his friend Scott, Charlie takes his research one step further and attempts to shed light on the phenomenon by making his very own crop circle. The humorous trip aboard an old AA van shows him that you only need to scratch the surface anywhere in this land to discover that folklore, myth and legend are very much alive and exert a beguiling power.

programme.title: Charlie Cooper’s Myth Country
programme.desc: Charlie Cooper has always loved the stories of King Arthur, especially the ones about his buried treasures. He digs out his metal detector, says goodbye to his family and embarks on an Arthurian investigation. He travels to Wales, the land of dragons and song, on a mission to discover if King Arthur was a real man or just a myth and if there’s any truth behind this treasure story. In the process, he meets treasure hunters of different sorts, a recorder of rare and ancient folk songs, and finds what he refers to as 'his tribe', a metal-detecting club from South Wales. He’s optimistic he will return home a rich man - if not in wealth, then certainly in knowledge.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May test the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte as they attempt to find the world's greatest four-seat supercar. After an early morning start in the City of London, the boys embark on a road trip across the south of England, stop off for a race around a closed-off business park, and end up undertaking a rather special chauffeuring job. Meanwhile, Richard is on the test track in two very different muscle cars, the Chevrolet Camaro SS and Mercedes E63 AMG. And there's a double dose of celebrity as Harry Potter star Rupert Grint and F1 ace Rubens Barrichello take their turns as the Stars in a Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Georgie’s best mate Vicky is the ultimate dating ice queen. Vicky is super-picky, has a long list of unrealistic criteria for her perfect match, dumps guys for using the wrong emojis, analyses everything they do and walks out of 60 per cent of her dates. Tired of hearing about Vicky’s first date failures and delivering advice that gets ignored, Georgie calls on sex and relationships expert Oloni for an urgent intervention. Oloni wants Vicky to see where it's all going wrong, so she dishes out some cold, hard truths as she unpacks Vicky’s dating history and shows her some frank and honest video feedback from friends, family and even exes, to prove to Vicky that her bad dating behaviour needs a serious reboot. Oloni has to pull out all the stops to melt this ice queen as she sets Vicky up on a series of first dates that will challenge her behaviour and make her a better dater. Under the watchful eye of Oloni and Georgie, is Vicky ready for a change, will she give the guys a chance, be nice and let her guard down, or will she retain her ice queen crown?

programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months. From planting shrubs and creating a striking winter container to laying a brick path, there’s plenty to be getting on with in preparation for spring. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden. Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, while Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations. There's also an allotment gardener in North Yorkshire carrying forward a love of horticulture that runs in the family, and a garden designer shows how structure and form can transform a garden even in the depths of winter.

programme.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
programme.desc: Plantswoman Carol Klein shares with us a year in her garden at Glebe Cottage in north Devon. Carol has looked after her garden for over 30 years, each with its own rewards and delights, as well as problems and challenges. Follow Carol as her garden grows, flourishes, dies and is reborn. The first episode covers January and February. The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do - cutting back, preparing the soil and planting garlic. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear as drifts of snowdrops carpet the woodland floor and hellebores reveal their ravishing colours. A local woodsman joins Carol to lay a native hedge. Slowly, the first signs of spring appear.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Nature is full of extraordinary surprises, and Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin are uncovering some of its more curious mysteries. Why do foxes' eyes shine in the dark? How did fish farts almost cause an international diplomatic incident? Does ivy really damage the trees it climbs? And how exactly do sea anemones deliver their sting? Together, they get to the bottom of these fascinating wildlife questions, with plenty of surprising discoveries along the way.

programme.title: Whisky Galore!

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above

At Scampston Hall we discover two superstar garden designers and meet young gardener Nathan, who is just starting out. At York Gate Garden, Christine catches up with an old friend and we discover the Yorkshireman who was the father of aviation.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean gets stuck into a cow pat to explore the hidden world of dung beetles and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field. programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie is at Loch Tay in Perthshire, where he gets an insight into the lives or our Iron Age ancestors and visits a reconstructed crannog at a prime lochside location. Arlene is in the Carse of Gowrie to find out how the community won the right to buy and restore a historic orchard. Rosie is searching for Scottish truffles on the Isle of Bute, Shahbaz is in the Cowal Peninsula to meet the couple rewilding their dairy farm, and Anne is in Angus, where she meets the chocolatier using locally grown berries in her confectionery.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt delves into the archives to bring an array of delicious recipes from some favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Alison Roman serves up her date and caramelised lemon pot roast chicken with a herb, garlic and pistachio salad. Owen Morgan brings along a taste of Spain, combining the flavours of mountain and sea for his chicken and seafood Spanish rice finished with a sherry and garlic aioli. Jamie Oliver takes to the hobs with an alternative to a traditional Christmas lunch: roasted venison loin wrapped in prosciutto, with a rustic celeriac mash finished with a chocolate and red wine sauce. Mandy Yin delivers big flavours with her Malaysian mussel and pineapple curry before Helen McGinn transforms gin, rum and vodka into three delicious homemade liqueurs. And Luke Evans tucks into either his food heaven, banh mi, or his food hell, braised oxtail. Meanwhile, Rick casts his net in the hope of landing a trout, while the Hairy Bikers are in Majorca to whip up a local classic.

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. But on arrival, they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer - put on a show! Christmas classic with a memorable score by Irving Berlin.

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Live coverage from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: For centuries, horses were integral to our working landscape, but horse logger Kate Mobbs-Morgan believes they still have a key role to play in our woodlands.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre’s Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula McIntyre invites TV personality Tom Read Wilson to her outdoor kitchen for a BBQ and a blether, before rustling up a perfect fish pie and an irresistible caramel nut cake.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the penultimate leg, the teams descend on the checkpoint in the dead of night. Can they make their way through Australia at speed to secure the second most important pole position of the race?

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: Lucy Worsley travels to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge’s Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice’s empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are in Hampshire to fish both the River Beaulieu and the adjoining Solent. They're here to catch mullet and later take a boat trip up the Solent to try for a smooth hound. The Beaulieu is one of only a handful of rivers privately owned in the UK. It's been property of the Montagu family since the 18th century, and Paul and Bob have been given special permission to fish here. Later, they are joined by their doctor friend Anand Patel for an evening tipple and an update on their health. Paul is keen to discuss his most recent diagnosis, while Bob asks Anand to examine his feet for a common sign of ageing.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: As their adventure nears its end, Bill still finds time to terrify Tom with his driving. A stormy round with NFL star Jason Kelce brings refuge in a stone shelter on the 7th, complete with pints and sausage rolls. In Dublin, Bill puts Tom in the spotlight for a change, before the pair reach the Giant's Causeway and reflect on a journey that became about far more than golf.

programme.title: Rewarding
programme.desc: Martina is gearing up for a date with a guy named Jacob and interrogates Francis about his obvious soft spot for Sinead. Sinead is rolling out a new care plan for Cal. Francis is offended because he and Cal have a system, thank you very much.

programme.title: Sunday Politics Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Mark Carruthers looks at the political developments of the week and questions policymakers on the key issues.

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: The fabulous Mo Gilligan introduces comedians Laura Smyth and Josh Pugh to the stage.

programme.title: Why...?
programme.desc: On 24 September 2025, the main road outside one of Bangkok's major hospitals collapsed. The giant sinkhole, the size of two tennis courts, snapped water pipes, ripped down power lines, and swallowed two vehicles. During the day, it continued to grow, threatening the foundations of the hospital and forcing close to a thousand staff and patients to evacuate the building. Ampan Vimonvattana, vice dean of Vajira Hospital, witnessed the collapse: 'The earth swallowed everything... it pulled the road surface, the soil, anything on top. Even the electrical poles got dragged down. It was really scary.' Why Sinkholes Collapse explores cases of sinkholes in Godstone, Surrey, a collapse under a main road in Yashio City in Japan and the underground quarries that are beneath ten per cent of Paris to help explain why sinkholes occur and how they can be prevented.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Armagh
programme.desc: Snapshots of life in County Armagh during the winter.

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Highlights from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: With energy bills set to soar 26% for millions of households from January, what can the UK government do to help people with rising costs? Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate from Clydebank, debating energy bills and oil and gas extraction, claims of avoidable deaths at NHS Grampian following accusations by a whistleblower surgeon, a drop in immigration, and trust in politics. Featuring the SNP's Stephen Flynn MSP, Labour's Melanie Ward MP, Reform UK Scotland's Malcolm Offord MSP, Scottish Greens' Holly Bruce MSP, and Scottish Conservative Russell Findlay.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: When an old friend returns, Martha faces the danger of exposure, forcing her to confess all to Kurt and make a risky decision to trust him. They must both keep Kamilla onside, even whilst keeping secrets from her and one another. Fuelled by both his complicated entanglements with Martha and Kurt and an effort to outmanoeuvre her, Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: A journey into the last great frontier on earth: the deep. It was once considered empty, but now, thanks to new technology, we know life thrives there in astonishing abundance.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: On a big Sunday of Premier League action, Arsenal face Manchester City, and it's Everton v Liverpool in the Merseyside derby. Brighton take on Newcastle, Crystal Palace play Hull City, Bournemouth go to Fulham, and Sunderland host Tottenham at the Stadium of Light. Presented by Gabby Logan.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Live coverage from day 3 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This edition comes from Dover Castle in Kent, where antiques experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon search for items to take off to auction. James unearths a silver owl inkwell, and Catherine discovers an alabaster bust. Paul Martin delves into the history of the English Channel.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by exclusively chatting to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition. Also, Friday’s all-star panel of Strictly alumni return to break down all the weekend action from the ballroom.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode, BBC Ukrainian Service reporter Anastasiya Gribanova sets out to uncover who killed her family. Following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, her relatives, like countless others, were forced to confront painful questions of loyalty and identity. Anastasiya's mother, born in Russia, sided with the Russians, while her sister refused to take either side. As divisions deepened, she broke off contact with them both. When, in early 2025, Anastasiya received a text message from her mother telling her father and grandparents had been killed, her life fell apart. After a year of mourning, she set out in search of answers, beginning a dangerous and deeply emotional journey to uncover the truth about how her family members died.

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Four more contenders face the black chair under the spotlight and the ticking clock in an attempt to become the next Mastermind champion. Clive Myrie hosts and asks the questions on specialist subjects, which this time are King John, the 19th-century designer and artist William Morris, the musical Cabaret and the professional wrestler Bret Hart.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. It's the third appearance of both teams, and a place in the next round is at stake. All they have to do is establish what connects a series of apparently random clues, such as ray, storey, underground storage and symbols of married status.

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: The round of 16 continues. Teams from Manchester and Warwick return to play for a second time, each hoping to earn themselves a quarter-final spot. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: Lucy Worsley has been given the keys to the spectacular palace of Versailles in France. The palace is huge – there are 2,000 rooms to explore, and everywhere Lucy discovers gold and more gold. This is one of the biggest and most ostentatious palaces she has ever seen. Lucy is here to find out more about France's most notorious queen, Marie Antoinette, who arrived at Versailles from Austria aged just 14 to marry the heir to the French throne. Her story is one of money, sex, power and snowy white goats.

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: In eagrán deireanach na sraithe, tugann Fiachna Ó Braonáin agus Eve Belle aghaidh ar The Linnet Inn i mBotha, Co. Fhear Manach. Cluintear ceol ó Houseplants, Seamie MacPeake agus a bhanna, Máire Ní Churraoin, agus ón ghrúpa snagcheol Le Chéile in éineacht le Múlú. Hosts Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle introduce an eclectic mix of musical styles. The final episode brings us to the Linnet Inn in Boho, County Fermanagh, and features performances from Houseplants, Seamie MacPeake and his band, Máire Ní Churraoin and jazz-folk group Le Chéile with Múlú.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

programme.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
programme.desc: In Madagascar, Rom hikes razor-sharp rocks, encounters alarming delicacies and comes face to face with the island's legendary dancing lemurs.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it’s a land of extreme contrasts. Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After a hair-raising drive across the Conor Pass and a spot of seaside silliness hitting golf balls into the ocean, Bill bids farewell to Chris O'Dowd. In County Clare, Bill and Tom's attempt to sneak unnoticed into a hurling match goes awry, before an emotional reunion recalls an unforgettable act of kindness. Then, a chance invitation in Ballybunion leads to a freezing Atlantic challenge.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: After a lab mishap, Looph’s new ‘size-o-matic’ machine misfires, causing her to shrink. Can she find a clever way to alert her friends and turn everything back to normal?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Rex is missing, but Dad, Cosima and Big Lizard need him to save them from a giant slug!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings are exhausted and just want to sleep, but Weasy starts snoring.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface is particularly tetchy this morning. He is packing for a skiing trip, but a dragon has pinched his golden fleece, and he urgently needs the heroes to quest it back – how else will he stay warm and cosy on the slopes? However, when the heroes accidentally agree to let his niece Trixie tag along with them, they fear that her clumsiness and lack of hero skills will ruin everything.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a mask that terrifies anyone who looks at it.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is working in a florist's, and Frog is a customer who wants to send flowers to his secret crush. However, his strong fragrance sends Duck into a destructive sneezing frenzy.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Dot and Penny infiltrate Exceed’s server room, but obstacles await.

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: Stella involves the Winx in the Princess Ball on Solaria. The girls do everything they can to make it the best day for Stella, but things seem to be going increasingly wrong.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Abby and Leo go head-to-head in a festive blacksmith challenge, Greg James and Chris Smith create an Advent calendar, and Shini introduces the latest read in the Book Club.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months. From planting shrubs and creating a striking winter container to laying a brick path, there’s plenty to be getting on with in preparation for spring. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden. Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, while Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations. There's also an allotment gardener in North Yorkshire carrying forward a love of horticulture that runs in the family, and a garden designer shows how structure and form can transform a garden even in the depths of winter.

programme.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
programme.desc: Plantswoman Carol Klein shares with us a year in her garden at Glebe Cottage in north Devon. Carol has looked after her garden for over 30 years, each with its own rewards and delights, as well as problems and challenges. Follow Carol as her garden grows, flourishes, dies and is reborn. The first episode covers January and February. The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do - cutting back, preparing the soil and planting garlic. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear as drifts of snowdrops carpet the woodland floor and hellebores reveal their ravishing colours. A local woodsman joins Carol to lay a native hedge. Slowly, the first signs of spring appear.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Nature is full of extraordinary surprises, and Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin are uncovering some of its more curious mysteries. Why do foxes' eyes shine in the dark? How did fish farts almost cause an international diplomatic incident? Does ivy really damage the trees it climbs? And how exactly do sea anemones deliver their sting? Together, they get to the bottom of these fascinating wildlife questions, with plenty of surprising discoveries along the way.

programme.title: Whisky Galore!
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy about a whisky-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. But it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus makes plans to expand the smallholding's herb patch. A trip to Gloucestershire to see the UK's largest herb collection shows that even someone as experienced as Marcus can still learn a lot about ingredients. Back at the smallholding, gardener Anatoli shows Marcus how to look after the bees and harvest the honey, and Marcus brings in some junior chefs to get inspired in the way the kitchen garden is inspiring him. Once the new herbs are in place, Marcus cooks up a herby feast for the people who have helped him along the way.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A beautiful building in Bath. Martin meets a couple who have bought a flat in a period, listed building, and luckily for them, they own the flat below too. In West Yorkshire, Martel meets two pals hoping to turn four flats into six!

programme.title: Kelly's Heroes
programme.desc: WWII France. When a German officer carrying some gold bars falls into the hands of a US platoon, Kelly and his sergeant Big Joe gather a team of men to 'liberate' the remaining ingots, worth millions, from a bank behind enemy lines.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest news, analysis, reaction and interviews from the afternoon’s biggest football matches.

Igglepiggle finds Upsy Daisy and then she knows what to do. She makes up her mind to go for a walk with Igglepiggle.

programme.title: Winnetou - O lume nouă
programme.desc: În cele trei filme, prietenia dintre imigrantul german Karl May, alias Old Shatterhand, și șeful apaș Winnetou este povestită ca o aventură în Vestul Sălbatic al Americii.

programme.title: Godzilla Minus One
programme.desc: După cel de-Al Doilea Război Mondial Japonia a pierdut totul, dar o situație proastă poate deveni întotdeauna chiar mai proastă. Godzilla își face apariția și trimite națiunea niponă mai jos decât a fost vreodată... la un scor negativ.

programme.title: Regele luptătorilor
programme.desc: Inspirat din faimoasa franciză de jocuri video, The King of Fighters este un film de acţiune cu elemente de SF, în care avem ocazia să urmarim nenumărate scene de luptă foarte spectaculoase într-un cadru narativ care se vrea original.

programme.title: Ultimul glonț
programme.desc: Când interlopii apucă pe calea războiului, viața asasinilor plătiți prosperă. Două familii mafiote reiau calea sângelui după trei ani de pace. Și cum să facă asta mai ușor altfel decât cu ajutorul asasinilor plătiți.

programme.title: Destinul unui războinic
programme.desc: Asiaticul Yang a fost antrenat toată viaţa pentru a deveni cel mai bun spadasin din lume, însă, atunci când îşi trădează clanul pentru a salva viaţa unui aşa-zis duşman, este forţat să fugă şi să se stabilească într-un oraş din Vestul Sălbatic.

programme.title: Prădător
programme.desc: Când Frank Walsh, un vânător și colecționar de animale exotice rare trimite un jaguar alb neprețuit pentru o grădină zoologică, crede că greul a trecut si va incasa curand cecul pentru ferocele animal capturat. Dar in cala navei este si un asasin...

programme.title: Regele cerșetorilor
programme.desc: Su Qi-Er, un celebru general al dinastiei Qing, se hotărăşte să se retragă din viaţa publică şi să se bucure de familia lui, dar şi să-şi împlinească visul, acela de a-şi deschide, în sfîrşit, propria lui şcoală de arte marţiale.

programme.title: Lungul drum al dragostei
programme.desc: In asteptarea primului copil, Missie si Willie LaHaye isi iau la revedere de la familiile lor si se indreapta spre vest pentru a incepe o noua viata impreuna si a pune bazele propriei familii.

programme.title: Evoluție
programme.desc: Comedia Evoluţie prezintă haosul care se instalează atunci când un meteorit cade pe Pământ, eliberând forme de viaţă extraterestră ce vor da un nou înţeles expresiei “supravieţuieşte cel mai tare”

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Charilie, o tânără de aproape 18 ani, îl găsește pe Bumblebee cu răni adânci și aproape nefuncțional. Între cei doi se va înfiripa o prietenie care va ajuta omenirea să scape dintr-o invazie pe cât de neașteptată, pe atât de periculoasă.

programme.title: Fiica regelui
programme.desc: În căutarea nemuririi, regele Ludovic al XIV-lea ajunge să captureze şi să fure forţa vitală a unei sirene, mişcare care este complicată şi mai mult când fiica lui nelegitimă descoperă creatura

programme.title: Destinul unui războinic
programme.desc: Asiaticul Yang a fost antrenat toată viaţa pentru a deveni cel mai bun spadasin din lume, însă, atunci când îşi trădează clanul pentru a salva viaţa unui aşa-zis duşman, este forţat să fugă şi să se stabilească într-un oraş din Vestul Sălbatic.

programme.title: Gemini: Conspirația
programme.desc: Will Smith e un asasin de elită care are pe urmele lui un inamic de două ori mai periculos decât el, pentru că este o clonă de-a lui, dar mult mai tânără.

programme.title: Călugăr antiglonț
programme.desc: El nu are nume. Apara un mare secret. Acum, pentru a implini o profetie straveche, l-a gasit pe cel care ar putea sa-i ia locul

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon: Eroi în largul mării
programme.desc: O poveste plasată pe platforma de foraj marin Deepwater Horizon, care a explodat în cursul lunii aprilie 2010 și a generat cea mai gravă deversare de petrol din istoria Statelor Unite.

programme.title: Obligat să ucidă
programme.desc: Hunt to kill este un film de acțiune, încărcat de adrenalină, despre un om ce apelează cele mai primare instincte pentru a salva singurul sau lucru de preț pentru care este dispus să-și dea viața - fiica sa.

programme.title: Crank: Răzbunare şi adrenalină
programme.desc: Un asasin este informat că a fost injectat cu o otravă care îl va ucide atunci când bătăile inimii vor scădea sub un anumit nivel. Bărbatul trebuie să-i găsească pe cei răspunzători şi să-i omoare înainte ca otrava să-l omoare pe el.

programme.title: Garda de corp
programme.desc: "Garda de corp" este un amestec de film de acțiune Kung Fu și film cu super eroi. Wu-Lin, protagonistul filmului, cauta răzbunare și ia legea în propriile mâini.

programme.title: Prădătorul din mlaștină
programme.desc: O familie foarte unită și mai mulți prieteni apropiați își unesc forțele pentru a vâna un rechin care a suferit mutații genetice și care a adus prăpădul în micul lor oraș de pe malul unui râu.

programme.title: Comando de sacrificiu
programme.desc: Bazat pe evenimente reale, din Al Doilea Război Mondial, filmul ne redă povestea adevărată de formare a unităţii - precursor pentru forţele de elită din Regatul Unit într-o misiune pe teritoriul ocupat al Norvegiei pentru a captura tehnologie nazistă

programme.title: Monty Python și Sfântul Graal
programme.sub-title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Filmul e o parodie dupa legendele cavaleresti britanice, intre care un loc de frunte il ocupa misiunea pentru Sfantul Graal a regelui Arthur. Acesta si cavalerii mesei rotunde pornesc intr-o calatorie initiatica, nici ei nu stiu de ce...

programme.title: Trisorii
programme.desc: În atmosfera cluburilor de pariuri din Los Angeles, înselãtoriile si trucurile sunt singurele reguli într-un joc în care nimic nu e ceea ce pare si nimeni nu îsi divulgã adevãratele intentii.

programme.title: League of Gods
programme.desc: Bazată pe romanul chinezesc din secolul al XVI-lea Feng Shen Yan Yi (Învestirea zeilor), povestea spune cum regele Zhou din Shang devine tiran datorită vicleniei lui Daji, un spirit viclean, deghizat în una dintre concubinele sale.

programme.title: Jumanji: Nivelul următor
programme.desc: În Jumanji: Nivelul următor jucătorii trebuie să înfrunte deșerturi aride și munți înzăpeziți pentru a scăpa cu viață din cel mai periculos joc din lume.

programme.title: Regatul interzis
programme.desc: Un adolescent fascinat de filme kung-fu ajunge ca prin minune în trecut după ce găseşte băţul de luptă al regelui. Tânărul Jason îl întâlneşte pe Lu Yan, cel ce-i va fi aproape în periculoasa aventură, aceea de a-l readuce la viaţă pe Regele Maimuţă.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: La aflarea veștii morții fratelui său, Shannon se întoarce acasa pentru a-i găsi pe cei vinovați și pentru a-și face singur dreptate.

programme.title: Inamicul invizibil
programme.desc: John Sands, un agent secret al fortelor aeriene, este trimis in cea mai periculoasa misiune: sa opreasca aplicarea un plan terorist aproape perfect. Sansele sa reuseasca sunt aproape nule, iar esecul inseamna si condamnarea lui la moarte.

programme.title: Como Matar o Seu Marido
programme.desc: Nancy Crampton-Brophy, conhecida por escrever sobre homicídios e relações tumultuosas, fantasias de matar ou fugir do marido e até simular a própria morte, foi detida em 2022 por assassinar o seu marido.

programme.title: Uma Mulher de Negócios
programme.desc: Uma mãe solteira cria um serviço de acompanhantes de luxo que liga jovens mulheres bonitas aos homens mais ricos e poderosos da cidade.

programme.title: Hitch - A Cura para o Homem Comum
programme.desc: Alex 'Hitch' Hitchens (Will Smith) é conhecido como o ´Doutor Engate´. É o agente de encontros com mais sucesso de Nova Iorque e consegue que até o homem mais medíocre tenha um encontro com a mulher dos seus sonhos. Alex consegue oferecer sempre aos seus clientes mais ricos o que eles desejam. Os casos perdidos como os de Albert (Kevin James) será um desafio para Hitch, que fará tudo para conseguir-lhe um encontro com Amber Valetta.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Halit confia em Yildiz e aproxima-se ainda mais dela. Ender perde terreno na sua luta contra a jovem.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T1 - Ep. 64
programme.desc: Betül tenta agitar as águas, dizendo a Songül que Haluk não gosta de Lale e que a incomoda. Todos ficam surpreendidos por Haluk e Songül já se conhecerem. Haluk está apanhadinho por Songül. Lale e Onur decidem viver em casas separadas.

programme.title: Amor Eterno T1 - Ep. 105
programme.desc: Emir está certo de que em breve encontrará o seu irmão. No entanto, no final da noite, uma grande surpresa aguarda toda a família.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (Tur) T1 - Ep. 38
programme.desc: Desesperado, Volkan recorre a Asli para que esta o ajude com a irmã, mas acaba por aproveitar a situação para lhe fazer uma proposta que não é bem recebida pela jovem.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (Tur) T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Nihat desconfia de Burak e tem a certeza de que este nunca mais voltará a pôr os pés na empresa, mas Selda acredita que ele vai cumprir com a sua palavra.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Jamie combate na crucial Segunda Batalha de Saratoga. Roger e Brianna procuram Jemmy.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Durante a sua lua-de-mel, na Escócia de 1945, uma enfermeira de guerra viaja no tempo de forma inesperada, até ao século XVIII.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Claire e Ian chegam a Filadélfia para ajudar Henry Grey que está em sofrimento. Roger e Buck recebem uma pista inesperada na sua busca por Jeremy.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Claire tenta encontrar consolo em John Grey para aceitar as noticias difíceis. Ian e Rachel falam do seu amor e do seu futuro. Brianna confronta um intruso em Lallybroch.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Após um encontro exaltado, as circunstâncias de Lorde John mudam. Um feito extraordinário merece uma oferta da parte do general George Washington.

programme.title: Ao Ritmo do Natal
programme.desc: Surgem faíscas entre uma antiga estrela da Broadway e o proprietário de uma escola de dança enquanto trabalham juntos para recuperar um tradicional espetáculo da véspera de Natal.

programme.title: O Véu Encantado
programme.desc: Primeira parte de uma nova trilogia em que três amigas de longa data — Avery, Emma e Tracy — compram um véu de noiva antigo em renda, que se diz trazer o verdadeiro amor a quem o possui.

programme.title: Segredos Mortais
programme.desc: O caso ilícito de uma jovem esposa de um militar termina em tragédia quando surgem suspeitas sobre o seu desaparecimento inesperado nas minas do Parque Nacional Joshua Tree.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: Cerca de seis meses após suas discussões no desfile de cães em Washington, a professora Elizabeth Scott (Cindy Busby) e o empresário/filantropo Donovan Darcy (Ryan Paevey) estão loucamente apaixonados e vão se casar.

programme.title: Uma Faísca de Natal
programme.desc: Molly ficou viúva recentemente e , com alguma relutância, aceita a tarefa de dirigir um espetáculo de Natal. Em breve, começa a apaixonar-se por Hank, o protagonista da peça e o solteiro mais cobiçado da cidade.

programme.title: Romance ao Acaso
programme.desc: A tenente Callie Jackson regressa a casa após uma missão militar e descobre que o restaurante do seu falecido avô está a atravessar dificuldades.

programme.title: Jogos de Natal: Regresso a Casa
programme.desc: Surgem faíscas entre uma professora de Biologia do Vermont e a sua antiga paixão do liceu enquanto competem numa tradicional iniciativa solidária de Natal para angariação de fundos.

programme.title: A Galeria dos Corações Partidos
programme.desc: Após o fim de uma relação, uma assistente de galeria reúne os objetos que foi acumulando ao longo dos romances da sua vida e monta uma exposição que inspira um movimento.

programme.title: A Cozinheira Curiosa: Mortinhos por Chocolate
programme.desc: Goldy Berry é uma empresária de catering do Colorado que se vê inesperadamente no papel de investigadora ao tentar desvendar a misteriosa morte de uma amiga. Com o tempo a escassear, estabelece uma parceria improvável com um detetive para encontrar o assassino.

programme.title: Um gosto pela Morte: Um Mistério de Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: Ninguém fica mais surpreendido do que Hannah Swensen quando a sua mãe, Delores, encontra o corpo sem vida de um proprietário — cliente habitual do The Cookie Jar — enquanto procurava uma casa para a sua irmã Michelle.

programme.title: Assassinato em… T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM DEVIL'S BRIDGE. Quando André Savignac, o presidente da câmara de Saint-Guilhem-Le-Désert, é encontrado enforcado na Ponte do Diabo, Marina Fazergues regressa à sua aldeia natal para investigar a misteriosa morte.

programme.title: Assassinato em… T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM SAINT OMER. A paz e o sossego da pequena aldeia de Doulac são ameaçados por um autor de cartas anónimas que promete revelações sobre um homicídio cometido há uns anos. Ao fazê-lo, o autor da carta anónima expõe-se à ira do assassino.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: Mevkibe pede ajuda a Can para descobrir se a sua comida é melhor do que a de Aysun. Sanem diz a Ceycey que sabe que ele gosta de Ayhan e ele pede-lhe que guarde segredo.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 32
programme.desc: Can está prestes a beijar Saném, mas Deren interrompe esse momento. Aylin fica emocionada ao saber que Emré decidiu assistir à filmagem para estar perto dela.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Aylín aconselha Polén a ficar atenta à relação que Can tem com Sánem, pois estão sempre juntos. Can e Sánem passam a noite juntos numa rede.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T1 - Ep. 74
programme.desc: Depois de um aniversário maravilhoso, Songül questiona Lale sobre uma carta que chega à casa na manhã seguinte. Será que o boato do contrato pré-nupcial é verdadeiro? Terá sido Pelinsu a enviar aquela carta? Estará Lale a dizer a verdade? A questão é que Songül vai descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T1 - Ep. 75
programme.desc: Não se sabe quem escreveu a carta a Lale. Pelinsu vai ao hospital, convencida de que foi o Dr. Onur que enviou a carta. Lale também vai ao hospital e fica surpreendida ao ver lá Pelinsu.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T1 - Ep. 76
programme.desc: Onur está dividido entre Lale e a mãe relativamente à rescisão do contrato. Haluk ajuda Onur nesse assunto. Nilüfer faz uma surpresa para Kurtulus, mas a casa acaba por pegar fogo e arder. Ambos têm de voltar para a casa de Songül.

programme.title: Flores de Aço (2012)
programme.desc: Um remake contemporâneo do clássico do cinema. A história narra a extaordinária amizade de seis admiráveis mulheres do Sul dos Estados Unidos, que sempre estão lá para enfrentarem juntas os triunfos e tragédias da vida.

programme.title: Como Matar o Seu Marido
programme.desc: Nancy Crampton-Brophy, conhecida por escrever sobre homicídios e relações tumultuosas, fantasias de matar ou fugir do marido e até simular a própria morte, foi detida em 2022 por assassinar o seu marido.

programme.title: Uma Mulher de Negócios

programme.title: 4 Mulheres Apaixonadas
programme.desc: Quatro mulheres vivem em Phoenix e são inseparáveis. Entre outros elos, une-as o facto de todas viverem relações amorosas decepcionantes.

programme.title: Uma Noite no Lago
programme.desc: Faye é uma viajante solitária que passa o tempo a pescar e a observar os pássaros e as estrelas num parque de campismo do Colorado, enquanto aguarda a chegada de Lito, uma figura do passado que embarcou na sua própria viagem incerta e nómada pelo inóspito ocidente.

programme.title: Amigos Coloridos
programme.desc: Dylan (Justin Timberlake) e Jamie (Mila Kunis) pensam que vai ser fácil manter a sua amizade, adicionando um ingrediente extra... o sexo. No entanto, rapidamente vão descobrir que uma relação física traz sempre complicações.

programme.title: A Lagoa Azul
programme.desc: Duas crianças, Emmeline e Richard e um cozinheiro são os únicos sobreviventes de um naufrágio e acabam numa ilha deserta. Quando o cozinheiro morre, as crianças têm de sobreviver sozinhas. Com o tempo, Emmeline e Richard vão-se transformando em adolescência, os seus corpos começam a mudar e nasce entre eles uma inocente curiosidade sexual.

programme.title: Regresso à Lagoa Azul
programme.desc: Dois jovens náufragos morrem, deixando sozinho o seu filho de dois anos. A criança é salva em alto mar por um barco no qual viaja Sarah Hargrave e a sua filha pequena. Quando uma epidemia de cólera é declarada, e para evitar uma morte certa, Sarah e as crianças são enviadas para um pequeno barco, Depois de varios dias à deriva, chegam a uma ilha deserta.

programme.title: A Lagoa Azul: O Despertar
programme.desc: Nesta nova versão, batizada de A Lagoa Azul - O Despertar, o casal é vivido por Indiana Evans e Brenton Thwaites. Os jovens se conhecem durante uma festa num barco, em viagem de férias pelo litoral caribenho.

programme.title: A Fuga do Culto NXIVM: A Luta de uma Mãe pela salvação da Filha
programme.desc: Uma mãe, disposta a tudo para recuperar a filha, expõe o complexo poder de sedução de Allison e Keith, bem como os abusos mentais e físicos infligidos à sua filha.

programme.title: Assassinato em… T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM COTENTIN. O corpo de um homem é encontrado numa lagoa no Cotentin. Testemunhas mencionam ter visto uma jovem ruiva vestida de branco. A capitão Hélène Ribero lidera a investigação, assistida por Alice Hamel, natural da região.

programme.title: Assassinato em… T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: ASSASSINATO EM PROVINS. Renan Thomas, encenador e ator, é esfaqueado enquanto atua em A Lenda dos Cavaleiros, um espetáculo medieval em Provins. Patrick Robin e a sua ex-mulher, Karine Demarle, ficarão responsáveis por este caso de investigação criminal.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Nihat e Mevkibé acham que Saném está apaixonada por Can. Além disso, Emré deixa Leyla à espera e Osman encontra-a.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: Guliz diz a Sánem que Polén viverá em casa de Can e ela decide não ir à festa. Can confessa a Sánem que é o homem que a beijou na festa da empresa e volta a fazê-lo, para demonstrar que gosta dela.

programme.title: O Meu Nome é Farah (Tur) T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Tahir diz a Farah que ela agora está por conta própria. Vera tenta comprar o silêncio de Farah sobre Kaan com algumas promessas.

programme.title: ASLI entre herdeiros (Tur) T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Asli não está disposta a deixar passar o roubo do seu desenho e enfrenta Çagla que não tem outro remédio a não ser voltar a recorrer a Volkan para a ajudar a sair da alhada.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido T3 - Ep. 72
programme.desc: A queda financeira de Halit abala toda a família Argun e obriga-os a abandonar a mansão. Enquanto Yildiz tem sucesso nos negócios, Leyla perde definitivamente e para sempre o apoio de Halit depois de serem descobertas todas as suas mentiras.

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido T3 - Ep. 73
programme.desc: Enquanto Halit e os filhos se tentam adaptar à nova vida sem luxos, Yildiz começa a ter sucesso no mundo empresarial. Ao mesmo tempo, Ender descobre o lado mais perigoso de Nadir e fica com medo por todos.

programme.title: Amor Eterno T1 - Ep. 106
programme.desc: Nihan fica furiosa com Kemal por ter denunciado Ozan e Emir à polícia, mas Kemal acha que já os deviam ter denunciado há muito tempo.

programme.title: Engana-me Que Eu Gosto
programme.desc: Na trama, Sandler faz um espertão que se finge de casado para atrair solteiras, mas precisa da ajuda de uma amiga (Aniston) quando sua nova namorada (Decker) decide conhecer a tal esposa.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 129
programme.desc: Huma pede a Aziz para afastar Can de Sanem, pois crê que ela o fará sofrer, mas ele tem planos muito diferentes. Mevkibe e Nihat creem que Emre engana Leyla e decidem segui-lo para descobrir a verdade.

programme.title: Pássaro Sonhador (Tur) T1 - Ep. 130
programme.desc: Nihat e Mevkibe mostram a Leyla um vídeo de Emre com outra mulher e garantem que ele anda a enganá-la. Can e Emre descobrem que Yigit queimou o caderno de Sanem.

programme.title: Quarto 309 (Tur) T1 - Ep. 65
programme.desc: O Dr. Onur tenta arranjar mil e uma desculpas para ficar ao lado de Lale depois de Pelinsu lhe ter contado toda a verdade. Onur e Lale decidem adiar o casamento. Pelinsu fica desiludida quando sabe as verdadeiras razões de tal decisão.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Após um encontro exaltado, as circunstâncias de Lorde John mudam. Um feito extraordinário merece uma oferta da parte do general George Washington.

programme.title: Outlander T7 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Brianna esforça-se para impedir um plano enganador que põe em perigo a sua família. Ian e Rachel dão um grande passo na sua relação. Um encontro surpreendente para Roger traz uma nova perspetiva.

programme.title: O Par do Ano
programme.desc: Depois de separados, um casal hollywoodiano ainda tem que manter as aparências para promover o filme que fizeram juntos. Para impedir que as coisas se desmoronem, o publicista do filme tenta desviar as atenções com uma história de que tudo está bem entre eles...quando na verdade, o actor está de caso com a mulher dele, e a actriz já arranjou um novo amor.

programme.title: Podezření
programme.desc: Ulice tropického přístavu San Juan, na ostrově Portoriko, jsou zaplněné k prasknutí. Koná se tu tradiční festival. Ti, co se veselí ani netuší, že ve městě došlo k dvěma závažným zločinům. V obou případech se stala obětí nezletilá dívka, kterou pachatel před smrtí znásilnil. Bohatý právník Henry Hearst se chystá se svojí o mnoho let mladší ženou Chantal na dobročinný večírek, když se ozve telefon, kterým ho policejní kapitán Victor Benezet vyzve, aby se krátce zastavil na policejní stanici k doplnění výpovědi. Hearst totiž objevil a ohlásil druhou vraždu. Banální vyšetřování se postupně mění v celonoční křížový výslech, při němž je konfrontována i Chantal. Je tu řada indicií, nasvědčujících, že ctihodný a vážený zastánce práva bude postaven mimo zákon. Ve chvíli, kdy se Hearst pod tíhou argumentů dozná, a Chantal připustí, že si dávno všimla manželovy slabosti pro dospívající děvčátka, dostane kapitán Benezet do rukou nezvratný důkaz. Svědčí ve prospěch Henryho Hearsta.

programme.title: Gothika
programme.desc: Skvělá a uznávaná psycholožka Dr. Miranda Grey (HALLE BERRY) je expertkou na posuzování toho, co je racionální. Co je logické. Co nezachází za hranice příčetnosti. Pod vedením svého manžela (CHARLES S. DUTTON), vedoucího oddělení psychiatrie Woodwardské ženské věznice, léčí nebezpečně psychicky narušené pacientky, mezi které patří i Chloe (PENÉLOPE CRUZ) charismatická vražedkyně, jejíž svědectví o satanistickém mučení jsou uvážlivou doktorkou považovány za pouhý výplod paranoidní mysli. Po setkání s tajemnou dívkou se však její spokojené manželství a vyrovnaný život změní v nejhorší noční můru. Když se Miranda probudí po hrůzné autonehodě, se zděšením zjistí, že její manžel byl zavražděn a všechny stopy směřují právě k ní. Zatímco se snaží přijít na to, za jakých okolností by vůbec mohla spáchat podobně brutální a otřesný čin vůči člověku, kterého milovala a obdivovala, ocitá se uvězněná ve Woodwardu mezi svými bývalými pacientkami.

programme.title: Poslední lovec čarodějnic
programme.desc: Armády lovců čarodějnic, bojovníci "Sekery a kříže", vedou svou válku proti hrozivému nepříteli po celá staletí a bojují s čarodějnicemi na všech místech Země. Jeden z nich, Kaulder, zničí samotnou čarodějnickou Královnu a ta ho s posledním dechem prokleje k věčnému životu. Navždy odtržen od své rodiny pak Kaulder tráví stovky let tím, co umí nejlépe - loví a zabíjí čarodějnice. Dnes je posledním svého druhu a prořídly i řady nadpřirozených nepřátel. Jeho příběh ani boj ale nemají konec, zlé čarodějnické síly tu stále jsou, ukryty našim zrakům. Navíc se jim konečně povedlo přivést zpět k životu svou Královnu a ta žije jedinou myšlenkou. Rozpoutat na Zemi peklo, ukončit Kaulderovu nesmrtelnost a postavit lidstvo tváří tvář zkáze. Posledního lovce čarodějnic čeká v knize jeho života epická a bojem naplněná kapitola. Bude poslední?

programme.title: Anakonda: Honba za krvavou orchidejí
programme.desc: K výrobě revolučního regeneračního a omlazovacího přípravku je zapotřebí látky, kterou obsahuje jeden druh orchideje. Potíž je v tom, že kvete jen jednou za sedm let, a to pouze na jediném místě na světě, kdesi na Borneu. Majitelé velké farmaceutické firmy se rozhodnou vyslat do oblasti malou výpravu pod vedením ctižádostivého přírodovědce Jacka Byrona. Je období dešťů a výprava jen s obtížemi sežene loď, která by se vypravila do džungle. Cesta neprobíhá příliš hladce. Nejprve jednu členku výpravy po pádu do vody málem sežere krokodýl. Potom dojde k poruše kormidla a loď se zřítí do vodopádu. Kapitán lodi Bill se mobilem domluví s kolegou, aby pro ně přijel, nikdo si však nevšimne obrovské anakondy, která kolem nich už nějaký čas krouží...

programme.title: Pád Třetí říše
programme.desc: 20. července 1944 byl spáchán ve Vůdcově hlavním stanu "Vlčím doupěti" (Wolfsschanze), atentát na Hitlera. Z bezprostřední blízkosti zažila tuto událost jeho osobní sekretářka Gertraud "Traudl" Junge. Poprvé se tak otřásla půda pod nohama kdysi všemocného "Vůdce" a všichni z jeho bezprostředního okolí poprvé pocítili šok. O devět měsíců později se Hitler přesunul do svého prostorného systému bunkrů na území Nového říšského kancléřství v Berlíně. Rudá armáda v téže době přistoupila k jeho totálnímu obklíčení. 20 dubna slaví Hitler 56. narozeniny v kruhu svých věrných spolupracovníků a svého štábu. Eva Braunová už s ním také několik dní žije v bunkru. Himmler, Goering a stranické špičky se odsunuly do bezpečnějších částí Německa, zatímco Hitler nechce v žádném případě opustit své hlavní město. 29. dubna Rudá armáda obklíčila vládní čtvrť a odřízla ji od ostatního území Berlína, v jehož ulicích se bojuje o každý dům. Během této noci diktuje Hitler sekretářce Traudl Jungové svou...

programme.title: Kull dobyvatel
programme.desc: Kevin Sorbo se stane vládcem velké říše, ale musí odolat zradě přicházející přímo z jeho paláce a ještě horšímu nepříteli - smrtícímu démonu v krásném ženském těle.

programme.title: Pane, vy jste vdova!
programme.desc: Panovník sousedního státu přijíždí na státní návštěvu. Incident, který má za následek vážné poranění vzácného hosta, přiměje druhého krále zrušit neschopnou armádu. Generálové se ovšem okamžitě spiknou a chystají se vladaře odstranit... Bláznivá česká komedie.

programme.title: Stážisti
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) a Nick (Owen Wilson) jsou prodejci, jejichž kariéru potopil současný přetechnizovaný digitální svět. Ve snaze dokázat, že nepatří do starého železa, se jim podaří téměř nemožné: získat prestižní stáž ve firmě Google. Problém nastane, když zjistí, že zde nejsou sami. Mezi dalšími zájemci o pracovní místa je celá tlupa geniálních univerzitních studentů, Přestože si tedy dokázali proklestit cestu do onoho pověstného světa utopie, mají vyhráno jen napůl. Teď je čeká souboj s elitou národa sestávající z technicky nadaných géniů, v němž mají dokázat, že nutnost je vskutku matkou invence.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Matt Murdock neměl zrovna ideální dětství. Vyrůstal v nebezpečné newyorské čtvrti, kluci ho šikanovali a příliš velkou oporou mu nebyl ani otec, opilec a zkrachovalý boxer, který pracoval pro místního zločineckého bosse. Navíc Matt oslepl, když se mu do očí dostala nebezpečná chemikálie. Překvapeně však zjistí, že díky neuvěřitelně zbystřenému sluchu dokáže "vidět", a začne tuto schopnost trénovat. Brzy se umí ubránit svým trýznitelům. Úspěšně vystuduje práva a je odhodlán bránit chudé a bezmocné. Pomáhá jim nejen jako "slepý" právník v soudní síni, ale po nocích také jako maskovaný mstitel Daredevil, který se v rudém kostýmu stává postrachem podsvětí. Seznámí se s Elektrou, která skvěle ovládá bojová umění. Je dcerou řeckého magnáta Natchiose, který se stal terčem útoku bohatého Wilsona Fiska. Ten na něj chce hodit podezření, že je obávaný vládce podsvětí Kingpin, i když ve skutečnosti je jím on sám…

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Zkušený badatel Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) najde minci, k níž se váže historická legenda. To ještě netuší, že se se svým parťákem Al Giordinem (Steve Zahn) vydá na největší dobrodružství svého života - honbu za pokladem tím nejnebezpečnějším koutem západní Afriky. Hledá ztracenou válečnou loď z americké občanské války, která až dosud ukrývá tajný náklad. Místní lidé ji znají jako "loď smrti". Dirk a Al potkají doktorku Evu Rojas (Penelope Cruz), krásnou a chytrou ženu, která se domnívá, že ztracená loď souvisí s širším ekologickým problémem, ohrožujícím okolní svět. Při hledání ztracené lodi, o jejíž existenci vědí nejenom oni, se Dirk, Al a Eva mohou spolehnout pouze na svůj důvtip, aby zvítězili nad nebezpečnými protivníky, přežili drsné podmínky a přišli na kloub nejednomu tajemství

programme.title: Na dostřel
programme.desc: Tom Hardy se policajtem stát musel. Je to už taková rodinná tradice - poldou je jeho táta, strýc, všichni bratranci, zkrátka celá Hardyovic rodina je policejní až do pátého kolena. Policejní a čestná, což zejména Tomovi přináší nejedno úskalí. Jednoho dne je při honičce na masového vraha zabit Tomův otec a Tom se nikdy nedokáže smířit s oficiální verzí vyšetřování, ani s odhaleným pachatelem. Podle něj je vrahem policajt. Svou tvrdohlavostí si jen škodí a poté, co jeden z jeho bratranců spáchá sebevraždu, odchází od policie. Pustne a za několik měsíců je z něj troska s příchylností k alkoholu. Živí se jako člen říční policie, zahrnován nenávistí a odporem bývalých kolegů. Pak ale přichází jeho nový partner - půvabná Joe a do Toma vjede nový život. Navíc ho čeká vyřešení série vražd mladých žen, které mají vztah k jeho minulosti a definitivní odhalení pravdy o smrti jeho otce.

programme.title: Neporazitelný 2 - Poslední zůstává
programme.desc: Profesionálny boxer George "The Iceman" Chambers sa práve chystá pre reklamné natáčanie odletieť do Ruska, no zlí chlapci z mafie mu strčia do kufru drogy a šampión putuje rovno do najtvrdšieho väzenia na Sibíri. Tu ho nútia bojovať v krvilačnom súboji bez pravidiel proti tunajšiemu majstrovi väzenia Uri Boykovi. Chambers sa nechce zúčastniť súboja, no pod nátlakom sa zúčastní a je podvedený. Teraz sa prebúdza jeho pravé boxerské ja, lebo k slobode vedie len víťazstvo.

programme.title: Tiché místo: Část II
programme.desc: Po tragických událostech musí rodina Abbottových (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) opustit svou farmu a pokračovat v tichém boji o přežití. Vydávají se na extrémně nebezpečnou pouť do neznáma a čelí hrůzám okolního světa. Během svého putování si však uvědomí, že u písečné stezky nečíhají jen nezvaní z hosté z jiné planety, kteří loví po sluchu. Stejně velké nebezpečí jim může hrozit od jejich vlastních lidí, k nimž se upínali jako k poslední naději na záchranu. Jak říká cynický drsňák (Cillian Murphy), ke kterému se přidají: "Lidi, co zůstali, si zachránit rozhodně nezaslouží." Scenáristou a režisérem děsivě napínavého thrilleru je John Krasinski.

programme.title: Temný úplněk
programme.desc: Legenda říká, že, kdo je zraněn vlkodlakem a přežije, za noci a za úplňku se proměňuje v tuto krvelačnou příšeru a zabíjí vše živé... Ted Harrison je chlap, jak má být. Rázný, sebejistý a plný života. Až do oné divoké noci hluboko v džungli Nepálu... Zatímco se miluje se svojí přítelkyní, objevuje se příšerná stvůra - napůl člověk a napůl vlk. Než ji Ted zastřelí, je zraněn a jeho dívka zabita! A protože se legenda neúprosně naplňuje, není Ted už tím mužem, jakým býval. Navíc odjíždí navštívit svou sestru a jejího syna Bretta do poklidné oblasti uprostřed hlubokých lesů a skal...

programme.title: Řežba v Tombstone
programme.desc: Když brutální gang ovládne malé hornické město, jeho členové v chladnokrevném souboji o moc zavraždí vlastního šéfa, Guerrera Hernandeze (Danny Trejo). V pekle se Guerrero ocitá tváří v tvář samotnému Satanovi (Mickey Rourke), který za ním přichází s troufalou nabídkou. Pokud mu Guerrero donese šest duší členů jeho bývalého gangu, unikne věčnému zatracení.

programme.title: Zametač stop
programme.desc: Policajt vo výslužbe (Samuel L. Jackson) šéfuje svojej vlastnej firme, ktorá sa zaoberá čistením miest činu. Čistí všetko, čo zostane na mieste činu po vražde, alebo úmrtí, ktoré bolo zistené, keď sa telo už začalo rozkladať. Na takéto miesto činu je objednaný aj teraz. Keď potom zistí, že zabudol vrátit od domu klúč a vracia sa aby ho vrátil, zistí, že v dome vlastne zahladil stopy po vražde, bez toho aby ju polícia vyšetrila. Dej sa postupne začne odvíjať a "čistič" sa nevie rozhodnúť, na ktorej strane vlastne má stáť.
